title: Agentic AI & Commerce Architect
description:
Role- Agentic AI and Commerce Architect

Location- London

Level- Senior Manager/Associate Director

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song

As an Agentic AI & Commerce Architect, you will lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of production-grade agentic commerce systems for global enterprise clients. You are responsible for defining the overall system architecture, selecting and governing AI/ML and platform technologies, and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and embedded into live enterprise commerce environments. You will partner closely with development, DevOps, data engineering, and client teams to translate agentic commerce strategy into executable, production-ready architecture.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of two rapidly converging disciplines — enterprise commerce and agentic AI. The primary hiring dimension is agentic AI architecture at enterprise scale; commerce depth is strongly preferred, and candidates with strong AI credentials and adjacent platform experience will be considered.

The Work

Architecture & Design

  • Design and document multi-agent architecture blueprints, agentic orchestration patterns, knowledge and semantic layer blueprints, AI governance blueprints, and AgentOps/LLMOps architecture

  • Design the knowledge architecture underpinning agent intelligence: embeddings pipelines, vector retrieval, and semantic search — structured around commerce-specific intent, product relationships, and category hierarchies

  • Architect the integration layer connecting agentic systems to enterprise commerce stacks (OMS, PIM, DAM, CRM, payments, pricing, fulfilment) via API gateways, event buses, and emerging agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, ACP, UCP)

  • Lead build vs. buy decisions across LLM platforms, orchestration frameworks, vector stores, and agentic workbenches; design multi-model routing strategies to avoid single-provider lock-in

  • Embed AI governance, observability, and guardrail design as first-class architectural concerns — audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation, adversarial testing, and compliance controls — not retrofitted after deployment

Commerce Platform Leadership

  • Lead large-scale agentic commerce implementations across Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, SAP Commerce, and composable/MACH stacks — embedding agentic AI into live production environments

  • Translate agentic commerce strategy into executable platform roadmaps grounded in the client's existing commerce stack and data estate

  • Lead architecture workshops with senior client stakeholders, presenting clear options with defined trade-offs, timelines, and business outcomes

  • Develop TCO models, effort estimates, and phased delivery roadmaps

Implementation & Delivery

  • Provide architectural leadership across distributed, multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning AI, backend, data, cloud, and DevOps

  • Guide the path from prototype to production — defining the architectural runway that enables rapid, CI/CD-enabled scaling of agentic solutions

  • Define and oversee the AgentOps/LLMOps framework: establishing standards for production monitoring, tracing, model evaluation, and continuous improvement across delivery teams

  • Define KPIs to measure agent performance, conversion uplift, operational efficiency, and ROI

Practice & Market Development

  • Shape Accenture Song's Agentic Commerce architecture standards, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators

  • Create industry-specific POVs, demos, and proposal assets for commerce pursuits

  • Engage C-suite stakeholders and grow engineering talent within the practice

What You Need

Must Have

  • 8+ years in AI/ML systems, with demonstrable experience designing and delivering Generative AI and agentic AI systems in production

  • 4+ years enterprise commerce delivery on one or more of: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, SAP Commerce, or composable/MACH stacks — or equivalent depth in adjacent enterprise platform delivery with a clear trajectory into commerce

  • Proven experience designing LLM-based systems: RAG, tool-calling, multi-agent orchestration, reasoning workflows

  • Experience with vector retrieval architectures and embedding pipelines in production (semantic search, RAG)

  • Experience designing AI governance frameworks: auditability, HITL, red teaming, compliance controls

  • AgentOps/LLMOps: observability, tracing, and model evaluation in production

  • Commerce stack integration: OMS, PIM, DAM, CRM, payments, and fulfilment systems

  • Proficiency in Python, agent frameworks, vector databases, APIs/microservices, distributed systems

  • Cloud delivery on AWS, GCP, or Azure; CI/CD and cloud-native architecture

  • Demonstrated leadership of complex, multi-region enterprise programs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with agentic commerce protocols: MCP, A2A, ACP (OpenAI), UCP (Google)

  • Hyperscaler agentic platforms: Google Vertex AI / Agent Dev Kit, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock Agents

  • GEO/AEO content architecture: structuring product data for LLM discoverability

What’s in it for you:

Our Total Rewards consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits. These include perks such as:

  • Up to 30 days of leave to spend each year plus 3 extra volunteering days per year for charitable work of choice.

  • Family-friendly and flexible work policies.

  • Attractive pension plan with financial wellbeing support and resources.

  • Private healthcare insurance plan and Mental Wellbeing support.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, Career Development and Counselling.

  • A range of generous Parental Leave offerings.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the outstanding services we are known for.

Please note that with all our roles, you should expect some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building rapport with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

title: Career Field Administrator
description:
Click on "Learn more about this agency" button below to view Eligibilities being considered and other IMPORTANT information. The primary purpose of this position is to provide developmental experience designed to broaden the skills and/or enhance the leadership perspective of an identified high-potential, mid-level manager/executive; it is not a continuing position and assignment duration is limited to 36 months.

DUTY 1: Analyzes and evaluates a wide range of complex AF wide functional requirements, objectives, operating methods, and new and proposed regulatory guidelines. Determines effectiveness of the Career Field Management Program relative to job assignments, career development and progression, functional and mission objectives, and career force structure. Develops and studies statistical, position, and organizational data, as well as technical or specialized operational data, to initiate appropriate career field actions concerning organizations and employees/positions in the assigned career field. Develops and plans milestones for successful implementation of these actions. Coordinates requirements and procedures with Air Staff functional managers and activities. Establishes work operations and controls to institute complex program concepts and provisions and assure effective administration of the career field. Plans, organizes, and administers meetings for Career Field Development Team (DT) and specific panels to review and approve program initiatives, procedures, and related business. Drafts recommendations for presentation to the Development Team on implementation of career development strategies. Utilizes qualitative and quantitative methods to assess and improve management systems processes. DUTY 2: Advises/counsels managers, supervisors, and employees on the continually changing needs of the functional career management program. Provides advice and guidance on career progression, training, assignments, program objectives, general operational requirements, and career management actions proposed or initiated in support of career program objectives. Coordinates actions with appropriate management officials, supervisors, and employees at all organizational levels as necessary. Advises Air Staff and operating level functional chiefs, senior Development Team members, and designated panel members on all aspects of career program training and development. Proposes new or revised operating procedures, program coverage, and other items for discussion and implementation. Utilizes personnel data systems to extract and review data to analyze and counsel candidates on career management programs or issues. DUTY 3: Analyzes and evaluates the force structure to identify training and/or recruitment deficiencies and categories of positions/employees to be included in the assigned Career Field Management Program. Formulates plans to correct deficiencies by preparing and/or identifying appropriate training programs, courses or sources of training. Establishes training and development programs to meet future needs. Administers and controls centralized referral for placement or promotion actions by screening employee experience and specific job requirements; determining applicability of assignment actions to both career progression and mission objectives; and certifying individuals for selection by functional managers. Develops and maintains career patterns, master development plans, and staffing qualification assessments in conjunction with appropriate functional managers and human resources representatives to ensure proper and adequate career progression and availability of a skilled work force. Prepares, analyzes, and makes recommendations concerning program criteria, types of positions to be included, functional coverage within assigned occupational groups and exceptions or waivers to existing policies and procedures. Reviews specific training/development requirements of positions and recommends individuals for attendance at long-term training. Monitors individuals in long term training and works outplacement follow-on assignments. Determines Air Force-wide need for career intern and career broadening positions based on projected requirements, funding, and functional area objectives. DUTY 4: Analyzes, develops, prepares and presents promotional material. Utilizes an appropriate combination of correspondence, publications, personnel media, guides, pamphlets, meetings, telephone calls, information letters and briefings to publicize the career program at all Air Force levels, to registrants and the functional community, taking into consideration such things as funding, the target audience, the message to be transmitted, time constraints, etc. Provides briefings for Air Staff officials, functional managers, personnel representatives, professional groups, etc., to outline program requirements and procedures. Briefs staff activities as required on program progress, proposed revisions, and management considerations. Provides assistance to Air Staff activities in developing and administering recruitment plans and actions to meet Air Force-wide needs in assigned occupational areas.

title: Commercial Credit Senior Associate, C&I
description:
Locations: Baltimore, Rockville or Falls Church

Overview:

The Commercial Credit Senior Associate plays a pivotal role in assessing and managing credit risk for commercial clients at M&T Bank. This position involves analyzing financial statements, monitoring loan portfolio, and ensuring compliance with credit policies and regulatory requirements. This client facing role serves as a critical link between relationship managers (RM) and credit risk management to facilitate sound lending decisions and portfolio management.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Focus on transaction execution and portfolio management and will partner with senior team members on complex transactions/account coverage.

  • Facilitate the credit needs of customers by underwriting new requests and material modifications from deal screen through approval and for the life of the loan. This analysis may include recommending adding or removing conditions.

  • Manage the ongoing credit risk of existing loan portfolios through continuous credit monitoring (CCM) activities enabling the timely identification of emerging credit risk so that appropriate actions can be taken to manage the risk, minimize losses and assign an accurate risk rating. A CCM program includes but is not limited to annual reviews, interim update memos, a covenant monitoring program, problem loan management, early warning indicators, and other forms of credit surveillance.

  • Review all pertinent credit and financial information, including but not limited to financial statements, tax returns, due diligence reports, credit bureaus, appraisals, internal credit information, industry research and peer data. Determine the need for more thorough investigation or additional information, and coordinate gathering of such information.

  • Analyze financial information and related materials and complete the credit analyses for the Bank’s commercial transactions. Written analyses to include an independent credit quality assessment with well-supported risk rating, identification of and description of credit risks and mitigants, industry concerns, market trends, financial trends, and other pertinent credit issues of respective deals.

  • Make appropriate structure recommendations based on an analysis and evaluation of scenarios including the company's case, bank's base case and a downside case.

  • As part of managing the ongoing credit risk of existing portfolios, identify suspicious activity and activity that may be contrary to customer's interest.

  • Partner proactively with relationship managers and be intimately involved throughout the deal process, from deal screen through approval and for the life of the loan to maintain timely and accurate risk ratings for a portfolio of commercial credits. Spread financial statements and prepare financial models designed to sensitize various conditions impacting the proposed transaction.

  • Prepare cash flow, collateral schedules, covenant sensitivity calculations, financial models, and guarantor statement analysis as appropriate.

  • Attend client/prospect calls with RMs to gain a thorough understanding of the client/prospect and their business to effectively analyze and underwrite the proposed transaction. Based on underwriting parameters, recommend the risk rating.

  • Prepare summary, present facts, and offers opinions concerning credit-worthiness. Assist in the structure of loan requests, where appropriate, to include suggestions on terms, conditions, controls, collateral, and guarantors.

  • Displays deep understanding of financial regulatory environment as it applies to underwriting most forms of commercial credit transactions.

  • Ensure credit policy compliance by verifying adherence of underwriting to the Commercial Credit Policy, and evaluating any risk associated with non-compliance Present analysis or address questions during credit request discussions or committee presentations.

  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

  • Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.

  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Scope of Responsibilities:

Commercial Credit is responsible for the credit delivery of the Bank's commercial clients throughout the credit lifecycle. Credit assessments range from initial analyses of new relationships to the Bank to material modifications or restructurings of long-term relationships and ongoing monitoring through the life of the loan. Commercial Credit is also responsible for ensuring the accurate completion of the Bank's risk rating scorecards and financial statement spreads. The work completed in this capacity is used to make credit decisions for new or renewed or amended credit transactions.

Position is an account coverage role and focuses on transaction execution and portfolio management.

The position interacts with commercial banking relationship managers throughout the bank’s footprint and industry verticals as well as other internal personnel on credit approvals.

Ability to lead a transaction execution team in partnership with a Commercial Credit Analyst.

Customer interaction is expected.

Works independently with limited supervision.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities:

Input into the development of and training of junior/newly hired Analysts.

Education and Experience Required:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field and 5 years’ experience in commercial credit, public accounting, financial statement preparation/analysis or other financial analysis. In lieu of a degree, a combined minimum 9 years’ higher education and work experience, to include 5 years’ experience in commercial credit, public accounting, financial statement preparation/analysis or other financial analysis.

Strong analytical skills with proficiency in financial modeling and analysis of credit metrics. Ability to calculate and interpret financial ratios, analyze date, and complete trend analysis.

Emerging proficiency with understanding and negotiating legal documentation including structural analysis and the ability to structure transactions independently.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer II based in India.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on maintaining and modernizing a business-critical billing workflow platform.
You will work across desktop application development, SQL Server, automated testing, and ongoing platform enhancements.
The role combines ownership of an established VB.NET application with opportunities to contribute to its transition toward modern web architecture.
You will collaborate closely with BI, analytics, processing, and submission teams to turn business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
The position offers exposure to technologies such as ASP.NET Core, Blazor, C#, Angular, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted development tools.
You will work in a collaborative, technology-driven environment with guidance from senior engineers while progressively expanding your technical ownership.
This is an excellent opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving real business problems while contributing to a long-term modernization journey.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance a critical VB.NET WinForms desktop application supporting monthly billing workflows.
  • Develop and optimize T-SQL queries, stored procedures, database components, and SQL Server Agent jobs.
  • Build new features, system enhancements, and performance improvements as part of an ongoing platform modernization initiative.
  • Contribute to the migration toward a modern web-based architecture, including technologies such as ASP.NET Core and Blazor, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Write, maintain, and expand automated unit, functional, and regression tests to improve platform reliability and test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and consistently follow established coding standards, development practices, style guidelines, and code-audit processes.
  • Work with BI, Analyst, Processing, and Submission stakeholders to understand billing workflow requirements and translate them into robust software solutions.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions covering both the existing platform and its future architecture.
  • Investigate and resolve application and database issues while supporting performance, stability, and maintainability.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code or comparable solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Estimate and deliver well-defined software solutions while progressively taking greater technical ownership.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to support continuous improvement of the platform.

    • Requirements:

    • 3–5 years of hands-on professional software development experience.
    • Strong practical experience with VB.NET and .NET Framework, including development and maintenance of production applications.
    • Hands-on experience building and maintaining WinForms desktop applications, including MDI architecture.
    • Strong T-SQL and SQL Server capabilities, including database design, query optimization, stored procedures, and SQL Server Agent scheduling.
    • Experience developing and maintaining automated tests within a .NET environment, including unit, functional, or regression testing.
    • Fluent English communication skills at approximately C1 level or equivalent, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
    • Ability to translate business requirements into well-designed, estimable, and maintainable software solutions.
    • Understanding of financial systems, billing processes, and invoicing terminology is highly desirable.
    • Exposure to C#, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, or Entity Framework Core is an advantage.
    • Familiarity with Angular is a plus.
    • Experience with Azure DevOps, including Boards and Pipelines, as well as GitHub and code-quality tools such as SonarQube, is beneficial.
    • Experience using Claude Code or other AI-assisted software development tools is preferred.
    • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to software quality.
    • Willingness to learn, work collaboratively, and progressively expand technical ownership with support from senior engineers.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, work-from-home opportunity in India.
      • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, technology-driven software engineering environment.
      • Hands-on exposure to an active platform modernization initiative and future web-based architecture.
      • Opportunities to work with modern technologies including ASP.NET Core, Blazor, C#, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted development tools.
      • Mentorship and guidance from experienced senior engineers while developing greater technical ownership.
      • Cross-functional collaboration with BI, Analytics, Processing, and Submission teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute to business-critical software supporting financial and billing operations.
      • Inclusive working environment that values diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Arlington County Government’s Economic Development (AED) Department is seeking a part-time Business Intelligence Intern to support business research, development, communications, and events within the Business Investment Group’s (BIG) portfolio.

Major Job Duties:

  • Conducting research on companies, industries, emerging technologies, innovation ecosystems, accelerators, investors, and partner organizations aligned with Arlington's business attraction priorities;
  • Developing and maintaining target company lists, structured datasets, and research summaries to support business development strategies, lead generation, outreach, attraction, and Arlington Tech Launchpad programming;
  • Supporting communications activities for Arlington Tech Launchpad and related business development initiatives, including drafting social media content, newsletters, educational resources, and other communications materials;
  • Assisting with planning, coordinating, and executing meetings, events, and ecosystem engagement activities, including preparing presentations, briefing materials, agendas, registrations, and other event materials;

  • Compiling reports, outreach summaries, engagement metrics, and stakeholder information to support evaluation of event participants and identification of high-priority companies and contacts for future engagement; and
  • Providing administrative and operational support to the Business Investment Group, including conducting ad hoc research, assisting with scheduling and internal coordination, and supporting special projects.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and organized individual with strong research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. They are able to work independently and collaboratively in a professional environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and demonstrate an interest in entrepreneurship, innovation, technology, and economic development. A multicultural mindset and interest in working with diverse innovation and business communities are also valued.

  • Familiarity with LinkedIn, Salesforce/CRM platforms, or digital communication tools.

title: Cash Voucher Assistance Specialist (DRA Project)
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ensure that Commodity Management is kept to WV and donor’s standard

  • Coordinate and communicate with local partners, agencies, NGOs and government institutions to perform accurate food security analyses and to ensure efficient delivery of food/cash assistance.
  • Ensure and/or perform accurate, timely recording of data within the specific technical area of work (e.g. assistance programmes, food security and vulnerability assessments) and consistency of information presented to stakeholders.
  • Work with programme teams and AP teams, WVM’s technical team to ensure that when and how food and cash programmes are being designed.
  • Ensure of needs assessment and market assessment in targeted areas are conducted, analyzed and provide information to management team for decision.
  • Support the capacity building of WV staff, partner staff, and national government within the specific technical area.
  • Oversee and/or review the work of other support staff providing practical advice and guidance, to contribute to delivering objectives to agreed standards and deadlines.
  • To provide effective specialized support and technical analyses to policy and programme activities that effectively meet food assistance needs.
  • Proactively engage partners in program development efforts, including supporting partner communications during proposal development processes and ensuring that the WVM’s partnership processes for proposal development are adhered to.
  • Participate in negotiate with food and cash aid donors and support offices to ensure the contract terms are satisfactory to World Vision’s needs and ensuring that WV will be able to comply with requirements of all contracts.
  • Maintain a comprehensive commodity tracking system and stand operation procedure of cash so as to ensure that all donor food and cash is secured.
  • Coordinate partner narrative and finance reporting processes, including review and feedback.
  • Coordinate and liaise with Senior Operation Manager and WV sector managers/ coordinators in order to develop an integrated program that includes food/cash as a strategic resource. Make representations with donors for funding of these proposals.

Encouragement, development and implementation of the program and personnel capacity building among project staff and volunteers

  • Facilitate the collaborative development and delivery of the partner project support plan, ensuring that it appropriately addresses issues identified in the due diligence process, and coordinate with relevant program and support departments for the timely, quality implementation of the plan.
  • Each food/cash program staff and program related agencies including volunteers, CBOs, village/camp level committee and partners are clearly understood and aware on program design and approach according to level of involvement through program orientation.
  • Contribute in the process of continuous learning and actively share learning with other teams within the organization
  • Ensure each team has access to WV’s food/cash training materials including the commodity manual, food monitors manual, pest and rodent control manual, warehouse chart, cash manual and SOP.
  • Develop partner, staff and volunteer capacity building strategy; conduct commodity management training, and Cash and Voucher Programme training as well as training on donor regulation with the help of WVM’s technical team.
  • Ensure each team has access to WV’s food/cash training materials including the commodity manual, food monitors manual, pest and rodent control manual, warehouse chart, cash manual and SOP.
  • Understand partner and staff capacity strengthening priorities ensuring WVM identifies opportunities and plans for support. Coordinate organizational development support to staff and partners.
  • Process any complaints from the field and provide feedback on the steps taken to troubleshoot the problem in the back end and provide technical guidance.
  • Work closely with the NO Response team members and other functions within WVM to promote mutual learning, support and accountability.

Ensure that all the necessary quality and timely reports are prepared and sent to appropriate bodies

  • Ensure the transaction of distribution report from all locations are captured in the database and produce the reports in a logical and systematic fashion which ensure quality and integrity of the data.
  • Monitor the data as it is entered into databased and note any discrepancies and check these with the staff in field office and partner.
  • Analyse report from all locations with project staff and note potential concerns. Highlight these concerns to the supervisor for further recommendation.
  • Submit all reports to supervisor and donor in a timely manner.
  • Make sure that all staff is conversant with WV requirements and donors standards in commodity handling and cash programme management.
  • Contribute to collating lessons learned in relation to project staff.

Maintain effective networking and partnership with donors and stakeholder perform other activities

  • Regularly attend food security sector and cash working group meeting or others meeting as required.
  • Regularly attend implementing partner meeting at the Donor office. Represent to local authorities and government and partners’ representatives in professional manner as required.
  • Participate in department meeting other staff forums such as operation forum
  • Perform other tasks as may be occasionally required for quality of food and cash programming.
  • Liaise with counterparts to ensure that all World Vision food/cash received is properly distributed and accounted for, providing guidance, advice and support whenever needed.

Ensure that ADP’s and partner’s good relationship and networking is maintained with community, government line offices, HO, donors, SO, and visitors

  • Identify and recommend other needs in the area such as health care, additional food needs (school feeding,
  • targeted feeding, etc), development activities, Provide detailed report to head office.
  • Assist the ADP manager in all areas of commodity management matters which shall include a periodical
  • review of the food security situation and food availability in the area.
  • Attend and participate in daily / weekly chapel and devotional meetings.
  • Perform any other duties that may be assigned by Management.
  • Carry out or engage tasks with good judgement and responsibly.
  • Perform additional duties and assignments proactively

KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND EXPERIENCE

  • University bachelor’s degree in any discipline is essential
  • At least 3 -5 years’ experience in a related field preferably in commodity management and logistics is essential
  • Candidates with a good accounting background can also be considered.
  • Ability to perform field assignments and willingness to travel for long periods of time in difficult terrain, harsh and demanding environment and circumstances.
  • Candidates should also be willing to live and work in very difficult areas.
  • Computer literacy would be an added qualification.
  • Ability to communicate and build relationships with local partners, government, UN and other bodies and to work in co-operation with other members of the team.
  • Amature Christian who shows a desire to serve humanity and to strengthen his/her relationship with the Lord.
  • Proposal Writing Skills is essential

title: Client Delivery Executive – Government
description:
What success looks like in this role:

Lead Service Excellence Across Critical Government Services

We are seeking an experienced Client Delivery Executive (CDE) to provide senior delivery leadership across a complex government account spanning Service Desk, Field Services, Project Services, and Service Management.
It is a senior leadership position focused on delivery assurance, governance, and commercial accountability, working through influence and strong partnerships with service line leaders to uplift service maturity, quality, and performance.

If you thrive at the intersection of service excellence, governance discipline, and commercial outcomes, and are comfortable leading in a matrixed, high‑trust environment, this role offers both impact and visibility.

The Opportunity

As the Client Delivery Executive, you will be the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes across the account. You will lead end‑to‑end service delivery through structured governance, clear performance oversight, and collaborative engagement, ensuring services are consistently delivered in line with contractual commitments and client expectations.

You will work closely with the Client Executive, service line leadership, and delivery teams to ensure alignment across operational delivery, project activity, and executive engagement, while maintaining a strong focus on financial performance and risk management. Delivery excellence in this role is also the foundation for growth: the credibility you build through consistent service outcomes will open the door to expanding our application and infrastructure support portfolio within the account.

This is a rare opportunity to lead delivery at genuine scale on an account of national significance. The services you oversee directly support critical government operations, and your decisions will carry visibility at the most senior levels of both the client and the organisation. Few delivery roles offer this combination of breadth, complexity, and executive exposure.

The account also carries genuine growth potential. The client relationship is mature, the delivery platform is established, and there is clear headroom to support the growth and delivery of adjacent service areas as client needs evolve. For the right candidate, this is a platform to convert delivery credibility into account growth, to build a high‑performing leadership network, and to position for broader executive opportunities. You will be trusted, backed, and given the room to lead.

Your Impact

Delivery Leadership

You will provide end‑to‑end delivery leadership across multiple service lines, ensuring consistent, high‑quality service outcomes through effective service assurance, performance oversight, and strong collaboration with Service Desk, Field Services, Project Management, and Service Management leaders. Your focus will be on lifting the maturity, integration, and value of each service line so the account performs as one coherent delivery capability rather than a collection of towers.

Governance & Assurance

You will uplift and lead disciplined account‑level governance, ensuring clear accountability, proactive risk and issue management, and continuous uplift in service maturity. Your leadership will ensure operational and project activities are aligned, transparent, and well‑controlled.

Commercial Accountability

You will own delivery‑side financial performance for the account, partnering with commercial and service line leaders to protect margin, maintain cost discipline, and identify and mitigate delivery and commercial risks early.

Growth & Portfolio Development

You will contribute directly to account growth by identifying and shaping opportunities to expand our application and infrastructure support portfolio. Working with the Client Executive and solution teams, you will translate delivery insight into credible growth propositions, ensuring the quality of what we deliver today earns the right to do more tomorrow. Beyond the core portfolio, you will contribute to the shaping, mobilization, and delivery of adjacent growth areas, bringing the delivery experience and capability needed to stand up new services with confidence and take them to a stable, high‑performing run state.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • NV1 Security Clearance is mandatory for this role. With ability to successfully obtain NV2 Security Clearance.

  • Proven experience in senior service delivery, client delivery, or account leadership roles within government or managed services environments

  • Strong understanding of IT service delivery and ITSM practices, with the ability to lead at a service assurance and governance level

  • Track record of contributing to account growth, with the ability, experience, and capability to identify, shape, and support expansion opportunities across application and infrastructure support services and to contribute effectively to the delivery of adjacent growth areas

  • Demonstrated success leading through influence in complex, matrixed delivery environments

  • Commercial acumen, with experience managing delivery performance, cost drivers, and margin outcomes

  • Strong executive‑level communication skills and the confidence to engage credibly with senior government stakeholders

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Catalog) (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

  • Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

  • Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Veterinary Assistant, Mobile Veterinary Services
description:
Summary:

Who we are:

Have you ever wondered what happens to cats and dogs whose owners are unable to afford veterinary care? We did. The ASPCA’s Community Medicine (CM) team provides expert veterinary care to support the welfare of animals and their people through our stationary and mobile veterinary clinics, serving the most underserved communities in New York, Miami, and Los Angeles. We help pet owners overcome barriers to care, bringing quality services directly to the communities that need us most and partially or fully subsidizing the cost of basic and preventive care. CM treats people and pets with dignity and respect, assisting pet owners in making informed decisions about their pets’ health and wellbeing regardless of their financial circumstances. When you come to work at the ASPCA, you join a team of over 1,000 dedicated colleagues with deep knowledge, skills, and passion for the animals we serve.

What you’ll do:

The Senior Veterinary Assistant (SVA) - Mobile Veterinary Services (MVS) is a vital member of our veterinary medical team. The SVA supports two program functions - mobile spay/neuter surgery and mobile primary pet care – for pet cats and dogs at various locations in the Greater Los Angeles Area. The SVA drives the mobile clinic from our logistics center in Paramount to each day’s clinic location to meet the rest of the medical team. Throughout the day, SVAs communicate with clients about their pet’s care, assist the veterinarian and technician with animal handling, preparing animals for surgery, entering medical records, and monitoring patients while they are under anesthesia. At the end of the clinic day, the SVA helps clean and restock the clinic and then drives it back to Paramount so it is ready for service the following day.

What you’ll get:

  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental, and optional vision coverage, as well as employer-paid life and long-term disability insurance.

  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, sick and bereavement time, paid parental leave, and company paid holidays. We also provide 1 week of paid personal time so you can observe the days that mean the most to you

  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar for dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year.

  • Robust professional development opportunities including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field and so much more.

Compensation:

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, training, experience, location, business needs, internal equity, market demands or budgeted amount for the role. The target hiring range is for new hire offers only, and staff compensation may increase beyond the maximum hiring range based on performance over time. The maximum of the hiring range is reserved for candidates with the highest qualifications and relevant experience. The expected hiring salary range for this role is set forth below and may be modified in the future.

  • The target hiring range for this role is $25.00 - $26.44 per hour

For more information on our benefits offerings, visit our website.

Work Schedule and Location

This is a full-time position, approximately 10 hours a day (including driving time), 4 days a week between Monday through Friday. The position requires flexibility to work occasionally beyond the scheduled work day. This position is primarily based at the ASPCA Mobile Clinics throughout the Greater LA area, however, the person in this position may be required to report to our South LA Spay/Neuter Clinic. Assignment to a particular mobile clinic is subject to change based on operational needs.

Responsibilities:

Responsibility buckets are listed in general order of importance. They include, but are not limited to:


Medical

  • Care for cats and dogs each day presenting for spay/neuter surgery up to calculated clinic capacity
  • Provide a safe and compassionate environment for animals in our care, our staff, and for our clients by using low-stress handling techniques during various procedures (examples: exams, treatments, injections, venipuncture, intubation)
  • Monitor vital signs of sedated and anesthetized patients in pre-operative, operative, and post-operative phases
  • Assist with patient exams, take medical history, perform diagnostic testing, and prepare medications to go home with the client/patient
  • Take direction regarding medical protocols and animal care from the clinic veterinarian or veterinary technician
  • Organize and maintain pre-operative area and operating room for patient anesthesia, surgical preparation and sterilization
  • Ensure anesthesia machines, pulse oximeters, scales, and other equipment are functional and report equipment that is not working properly
  • Clean, sonicate, pack, and sterilize surgical instruments and endotracheal tubes
  • Work with coworkers to clean and disinfect animal areas and facility while utilizing appropriate personal protective equipment

Customer Service

  • Communicate with all clients in a non-judgmental, effective and professional manner
  • Greet clients and assist with the intake process, including assisting clients in filling out intake and service documents, flag relevant medical history
  • Communicate basic veterinary medical concepts to clients, including, but not limited to vaccine protocols and anesthetic risks
  • Explain information provided by the veterinarian about an animal’s condition to clients

Other

  • Safely drive and park mobile clinics to and from various locations in Los Angeles County
  • Operate and troubleshoot mobile clinic generators
  • Enter medical information into digital data bases as appropriate
  • Represent ASPCA in a professional and courteous manner
  • Provide medical information and representation to other ASPCA departments
  • Adhere to all protocols put forth by Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and Department of Transportation (DOT)
  • Follow all written and verbally communicated CM Standard Operating Procedures
  • Collaborate and foster good communication with ASPCA colleagues
  • Participate in the training of CM staff by coaching, discussion, and demonstration
  • Attend staff meetings and training sessions
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Experience using a computer and navigating software applications
  • Ability to lift and carry 40-plus pounds repeatedly throughout day with assistance
  • Ability to work standing for 10 or more hours
  • Fear Free® Shelter certification is required within 60 days of hire
  • Driving requirements:
  • Must be willing and comfortable learning to drive our 37’ Mobile Clinics (training provided by ASPCA)
  • Must provide a valid driver’s license upon hire
  • Must pass a motor vehicle history check demonstrating a safe driving history
  • Must pass a Department of Transportation Medical Exam
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work efficiently and calmly under challenging conditions
  • Must maintain open mind regarding changes and be willing to learn, implement, and teach new protocols
  • Excellent animal handling skills (cats, dogs)
  • Strong interest in animal welfare and serving underserved communities
  • Ability to exemplify ASPCA’s core values and behavioral competencies.

Education and Work Experience

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required
  • Minimum 1 year animal handling in a professional setting preferred, veterinary medical experience preferred
  • Veterinary medical experience preferred

Language:

English (Required)

Bilingual (Spanish, Vietnamese, Mandarin, Cantonese, etc.) Strongly Preferred

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a full-stack developer to join a growing InsurTech business unit (headquartered in Reigate) building market-leading insurance software with a focus on the development of modern SaaS based solutions.

You will join at a genuine inflection point: we are moving from AI-assisted coding toward an agentic software development lifecycle, where engineers increasingly describe intent, and orchestrate, review and govern the work that AI executes.

The Role

Today the role focuses on:

  • Working with the Product Owner to define, refine and deliver the product backlog.

  • Designing and building software solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements, using AI coding tools to accelerate delivery.

  • Writing and maintaining test-related code - unit tests, test frameworks and automated test cases.

  • Reviewing and debugging code to identify defects, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt.

  • Participating in Agile/scrum activities (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and continuously improving team velocity, process and engineering practice.

  • Participating in incident response and continuously harden the platform based on production learnings

The role will evolve and we expect more focus on:

  • Business outcomes - partnering closely with business stakeholders to understand underlying needs, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and measure success through tangible business and user outcomes.

  • Design over implementation - spending more time defining system boundaries, integration patterns and architectural intent, using AI-assisted tools to explore solutions and validate design decisions before code is written.

  • Specification as a first-class craft - writing clear, testable intent and acceptance criteria that agents and humans can both act on.

  • Review and quality judgement - evaluating AI-generated work for correctness, security and design fit, rather than typing every line yourself.

  • Orchestration - composing and supervising AI capabilities and agentic workflows inside governed pipelines with clear quality gates.

  • Raising the team, not just yourself - turning good individual practice into shared, reusable capability so the whole team gets faster, not just one person.

  • Learning and adaptation - staying current with emerging AI capabilities and engineering practices, helping the team identify, adopt and govern new ways of working that improve delivery and outcomes.



Qualifications

What you’ll bring

Core engineering

  • Solid full-stack development experience across modern front-end and back-end technologies, with cloud/SaaS exposure.

  • Strong grasp of software design, testing and quality fundamentals - you know what good looks like and can articulate why.

  • Comfortable working in Agile/scrum teams and collaborating closely with Product.

AI fluency

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agentic tools in real delivery - and, more importantly, good judgement about when to trust, correct or override them.

  • Able to write clear specifications and prompts, and to critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability.

  • Curious and self-directed about emerging AI engineering practice - you actively experiment rather than wait to be trained. (Specific tools matter less than the fluency and judgement; the toolchain will keep changing.)

Mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change - you can do valuable work today while the operating model around you is still forming.

  • Passion for complex problem solving, as well as statistics and algorithm development

  • T-shaped: deep enough to be trusted, broad enough to move across the lifecycle as roles blur.

  • Sees reviewing and specifying as real engineering and an opportunity to deliver even more value, not a step down from writing code.

  • A growth mindset and a bias to improve the system, not just complete the ticket.

  • General knowledge of the insurance industry and degree level education in a relevant discipline is highly desirable but not essential.

What we offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Location: Polanco, CDMX

As an Automation Engineer, you will own the deployment and integration of real-time power management and SCADA solutions at such as utilities, industrial facilities, data centers, oil & gas and critical infrastructure clients across The Americas and internationally. You will work hands-on with one of the most technically advanced power systems platforms available today — configuring, commissioning, and delivering projects end-to-end for English-speaking clients across the US, Middle East, India, and Asia.

This is a mid-level role for an engineer who is ready to stop doing the same project repeatedly and start building depth across a genuinely complex and varied portfolio. You will have direct proximity to the product teams behind the platform you deploy — something no third-party integrator can offer. If you are looking for a role where your technical decisions matter and your exposure grows faster than it would in a specialized position, this is that role.

Responsibilities - You will do:

  • Own end-to-end deployment and integration of ETAP Real-Time solutions including Power Management Systems, Electrical SCADA, and Digital Twin implementations

  • Lead client-facing technical communication including project scope definition, delivery updates, and commissioning handover

  • Configure and integrate RTU and field device communication using standard industrial protocols including Modbus, DNP3, IEC 104, IEC 61850, and OPC UA

  • Program and configure RTUs and field controllers using IEC 61131-3 languages including Structured Text and Function Block Diagrams

  • Connect to and manage protective relays including settings file retrieval, configuration, and database management for asset management projects

  • Design and develop electrical HMI graphics representing client power systems, substations, and control schemes

  • Build and maintain one-line diagram models representing client electrical networks

  • Independently troubleshoot and resolve SCADA communication, HMI, and power management issues before escalating

  • Perform and lead functional testing, commissioning, and client training at project sites across The Americas and internationally

  • Identify and communicate project risks, technical blockers, and scope changes proactively to project management

  • Informally support and guide junior engineers on technical tasks and project delivery standards

Requirements - You need to have:

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher) — while this position is based in Mexico, the majority of clients span the US, Middle East, India, and Asia

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience delivering electrical SCADA or power monitoring projects using platforms such as Schneider Power Monitoring Expert, Survalent, GE GridSolutions, or similar

  • Demonstrated experience building HMI graphics and configuring device communication within an electrical SCADA or power monitoring environment

  • Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus and DNP3 — point mapping, device configuration, and basic troubleshooting are expected

  • Practical experience with industrial networking including IP addressing and communication architecture for automation systems

  • Strong computer proficiency with hands-on experience configuring systems, managing software environments, and troubleshooting technical issues independently

  • Foundational understanding of electrical power distribution and substation automation concepts sufficient to read a single-line diagram and explain basic system behavior to a client operator

A Plus to have:

  • Experience with OPC UA or IEC 61850 MMS for third-party system integration

  • Programming experience using IEC 61131-3 languages, specifically Structured Text or Function Block Diagrams, for RTU or PLC automation applications

  • Basic familiarity with protective relays and IEDs including connecting to devices and retrieving settings or event records

  • Exposure to IEC 61850 GOOSE messaging in a substation automation context

  • Field commissioning experience on substation automation or power monitoring projects

  • Experience with ADMS, EMS, or Distribution Management Systems

Role: NAB's Domain Delivery Cycle requires architecture to be embedded early in the delivery chain — shaping and assessing the pipeline of Business Outcomes and Epics, preventing ill-formed work from entering the backlog, and ensuring solutions align with technology strategy and patterns.

Essential capabilities:

  • Produce and maintain the Domain Roadmap, defining transition states and sequencing to realise target state.
  • Work with domain stakeholders and Product Owners to prioritise the delivery slate based on risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
  • Function as the recognised SME on projects within the domain — providing technical authority and influencing project and domain stakeholders, documenting and approving solution architectures.

  • Maintain domain artefacts — policies, NFRs, patterns, processes, and enterprise security architecture.

Experience:

  • 20+ years experience in technology or security roles, with a significant portion in solution architecture, technical delivery, or hands-on security engineering within the relevant domain.
  • Demonstrated experience producing domain or capability roadmaps that informed investment prioritisation and delivery sequencing within a large, complex enterprise.
  • Demonstrated experience functioning as an architectural SME on projects — providing technical authority, shaping solution direction, and influencing project stakeholders to adopt sound architectural approaches.
  • Demonstrated experience working with domain leadership and product owners to prioritise and sequence the delivery slate, balancing competing demands across risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
  • Experience providing architectural oversight across concurrent projects, including solution endorsement, options assessment, and tech debt governance.
  • Experience working within structured delivery cycles — embedded alongside product owners, delivery teams, and engineering in an agile environment.
  • Experience in Australian financial services or similarly regulated industries preferred.

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:

title: Head of Facilities
description:
Who We Are

GITAI is a vertically integrated space and defense company building the next generation of hardware for low-Earth-orbit missions.

At our core is the space robotics technology that has defined GITAI from the beginning. A small, highly capable engineering team applies that foundation across satellite buses, in-orbit servicing robotics, and mission hardware for applications such as Earth observation. Today, a major focus of our work is supporting U.S. national security missions, particularly through proliferated LEO satellite constellations and other next-generation space systems.

We design, build, integrate, and test much of our hardware in-house. Electrical, mechanical, software, manufacturing, integration, and test teams work closely together, allowing a small team to own complete systems rather than isolated components. This vertical integration helps us move quickly, learn directly from hardware, and shorten the path from architecture to a working system.

We are still early. The systems, the company, and the market are all being built at the same time. Requirements change, technical problems are often ambiguous, and many answers do not yet exist. We are looking for exceptional engineers and operators who want broad ownership, can work across disciplines, and are willing to stay close to the hardware until the mission succeeds.

Your Mission

As Head of Facilities, you will build the physical foundation for GITAI’s next stage of growth, owning the infrastructure that enables us to scale engineering, manufacturing, integration, and testing across our offices, manufacturing environments, remote test sites, and facilities supporting U.S. government programs. This is initially a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You will work directly with Engineering and Operations leadership and serve as the central owner across internal teams, contractors, consultants, landlords, utilities, regulatory authorities, government stakeholders, and security teams. Many of the environments GITAI needs do not yet exist, and requirements will often be incomplete or based on assumptions. You will seek primary information yourself, get close to the hardware and the people doing the work, identify the real constraint, and determine what should actually be built. You will turn those needs into working physical environments, making practical decisions across facilities, equipment, utilities, layout, permitting, security, cost, and schedule. The work will include technically demanding and highly regulated environments involving explosives, energetic and hazardous materials, and U.S. government security requirements. As GITAI grows, you may eventually build a facilities team, but this will remain a hands-on role. Your mission is to build the launchpad that enables GITAI’s engineers to move faster, test more, solve harder problems, and deliver their best work.

What You’ll Drive

  • Own GITAI’s facility strategy and execution across offices, engineering and manufacturing environments, remote test sites, and facilities supporting U.S. government programs.
  • Translate technical and operational needs into practical infrastructure decisions across space, power, HVAC, utilities, equipment, safety, security, manufacturing areas, laboratories, and test environments. Challenge assumptions when a simpler or more effective solution exists.
  • Lead site selection, facility due diligence, lease-related coordination, renovations, buildouts, permitting, inspections, construction, commissioning, and major infrastructure upgrades from initial need through completion.
  • Own the facility-side path through regulatory, permitting, and security requirements, including those associated with explosives, energetic materials, hazardous materials, fire and life safety, environmental constraints, classified or cleared spaces, and operations at remote or government-controlled locations.
  • Serve as the central hub across internal stakeholders and external partners. Define scope, manage budgets and schedules, negotiate with vendors and contractors, and drive decisions across landlords, brokers, consultants, general contractors, utilities, regulatory authorities, government stakeholders, and security teams.
  • Stay close to the work. Walk the floor, inspect prospective sites and construction, review drawings and bids, investigate infrastructure problems yourself, and drive issues through closure.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in facilities, construction, industrial infrastructure, facilities engineering, manufacturing operations, or a closely related field.
  • Experience owning significant facility buildouts, expansions, relocations, test-site development, or infrastructure projects in a technically demanding environment such as aerospace, defense, propulsion, robotics, advanced manufacturing, automotive, energy, or laboratories.
  • Strong practical understanding of industrial building infrastructure and facility development, including electrical power, HVAC, utilities, building systems, permitting, inspections, and construction.
  • Demonstrated experience navigating permits, regulations, and approval processes for technically complex facilities. Experience with explosives, energetic materials, hazardous materials, or similarly regulated operations is required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, modifying, or operating facilities subject to U.S. government security requirements, including classified or cleared work environments, physical security requirements, controlled access, and coordination with security stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment under ambiguity. You can separate the real requirement from assumptions and turn incomplete engineering or operational needs into a practical solution.
  • Strong commercial and execution judgment across scopes of work, budgets, schedules, contractor selection, negotiations, and project delivery.
  • A hands-on operating style. You actively seek primary information and are comfortable moving between executive-level decisions, regulatory and security discussions, contractor coordination, and physical problems on the floor, at a construction site, or at a remote test site.
  • U.S. citizenship is required due to the nature of GITAI’s work with U.S. government customers and programs. This role may require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Strong plus:

  • Experience building or scaling facilities at an early-stage hardware company.
  • Experience developing or operating remote test sites, field facilities, or infrastructure on government or highly regulated sites.
  • Experience with specialized technical environments such as machine shops, laboratories, clean or controlled areas, high-power equipment, environmental testing, or propulsion test infrastructure.
  • General Contractor license, PE, PMP, or other relevant professional qualification.

Location and Position Type

  • Location: Torrance, CA
  • Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
  • Work Arrangement: Onsite, five days per week
  • Travel: Approximately 25–30% travel is expected, primarily within Southern California. This role will regularly support remote test sites and other project locations, including recurring overnight stays. Travel frequency may increase temporarily during facility buildouts, construction, testing, or commissioning activities.
  • Typical Work Hours: Monday to Friday, approximately 9:00am to 6:00pm. Flexibility is expected based on construction schedules, facility issues, test activities, permitting and inspection schedules, security requirements, and program needs.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is expected to be $150,000 to $200,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, demonstrated ability to lead complex facility and infrastructure projects, experience supporting technical hardware environments, and other job-related factors. This position is also eligible for stock options and company benefits.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, with 90% coverage for dependents, plus life insurance
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a company match
  • Equity Opportunities: Stock options in a rapidly growing startup, giving you a stake in our success
  • Relocation Support: Financial assistance for relocation is available for candidates residing outside the Los Angeles area
  • Paid Time Off: 12 days of paid time off (PTO) and 12 company holidays annually
  • Office Perks: Enjoy free snacks and drinks, plus regular social events to foster team spirit

No agency submissions, please.

Compensation may include base salary or hourly pay and, depending on the position, equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skillset, and other job-related factors.

LA salary range
$150,000—$200,000 USD

Important Notice

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
  • To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), GITAI Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable.
  • GITAI USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment with GITAI USA is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

This position will be responsible for ensuring the safety of all aquatic participants.

The Long Bridge Aquatics & Fitness Center has something for everyone! A 50-Meter FINA compliant pool, a Leisure Pool with in-water volleyball & basketball, and a lazy river, along with a fitness studio, three community rooms, and two wet-classrooms for fitness classes, parties, and gatherings.

  • Serving as an on-deck lifeguard to cover shifts or work a regularly scheduled on-deck shift;
  • Providing emergency care and treatment;
  • Completing incident/accident reports, shift reports, water emergency reports, and water chemistry logs;
  • Ensuring compliance with County policies and procedures and Health and safety standards; and
  • Performing other job-related duties as assigned.

The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of lifeguarding and best practices related to pool safety.

Minimum: Must have the ability to swim proficiently.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Must possess an American Red Cross Lifeguarding (Including Deep Water) certification or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
  • Must possess CPR, First Aid/AED certifications or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.

Desirable: Preference may be given to applicants with experience/credentials in one or more of the following:

  • Experience as a Lifeguard; and

Possession of one or more of the following Certifications/Licenses preferred:

  • American Red Cross Lifeguarding (Including Deep Water) license.
  • American Red Cross Water Attraction License;
  • Certified Pool Operator (CPO); and
  • CPR, AED, and FirstAid certifications.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Work Hours: This is a temporary occasional position.

title: Engineering Technical (Mechanical)
description:
The Sub-millimeter Array (SMA) is a joint project of the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory (SAO). The observatory consists of a control building and hangar, eight relocatable antennas and associated instrumentation on the summit of Maunakea. The SMA is a radio interferometer array that conducts astronomical observations at millimeter and sub-millimeter wavelengths from 180 GHz to 420 GHz.

Conduct field inspections, measurements, and data collection for mechanical systems such as HVAC, pumps, piping, boilers, chillers, compressors, and fluid distribution systems.

Perform calculations related to flow, pressure, heat transfer, load, and system performance using established formulas and engineering references.

Read existing designs to complete packages, installation checklists, machine parts lists, and specifications of instrumentation equipment.

Assemble modified or new mechanical components for equipment and industrial and scientific machinery.

Conduct limited troubleshooting and diagnostics on mechanical equipment, identifying routine issues and recommending corrective actions.

Manage SMA's day to day operations of the fleet center; overseeing a diverse fleet including four wheel drive vehicles.

Provide technical assistance in developing maintenance and/or repair of precision mechanical assemblies at the observatory, including antennas, antenna transporter, and infrastructure.

Operate specialized bridge cranes, hoists and forklift trucks used in the assembly and maintenance of large antenna components.

Work with the antenna transporter, which is used to move the antennas.

description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact.
