description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role

Defines, designs, develops, and supports connectivity solutions enabling connected machines, digital services, remote operations, and autonomous systems. Provides technical leadership across networking, edge computing, cloud connectivity, telemetry, and data pipeline architectures. Leads technical design, implementation, validation, and operational support of connectivity platforms while influencing architecture decisions and engineering best practices.

What You Will Do:

  • Leads the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of connectivity solutions across machine, site, edge, and cloud environments.
  • Develops software and infrastructure supporting machine telemetry, remote monitoring, autonomous operations, and digital services.
  • Evaluates and implements connectivity technologies including cellular (LTE/5G), satellite communications (Starlink), Wi-Fi, edge computing, and industrial networking solutions.
  • Designs reliable and scalable telemetry and data transport architectures from machines and edge devices to enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Collaborates with product managers, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Leads technical investigations and root cause analysis for connectivity, networking, and data pipeline issues.
  • Establishes engineering standards, design patterns, and best practices for connectivity solutions.
  • Reviews solution architectures and provides recommendations regarding scalability, resiliency, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Mentors engineers and contributes technical leadership across project teams.
  • Supports integration of connectivity solutions with cloud platforms, data services, cybersecurity requirements, and enterprise systems.
  • Identifies emerging technologies and recommends innovations that improve platform capability and customer value.

.

What You Will Have:

Connectivity Systems Engineering

  • Demonstrates expertise in connectivity technologies including cellular, satellite communication, edge computing, and industrial networking.
  • Designs and implements resilient communication architectures for distributed systems.
  • Evaluates connectivity technologies based on reliability, cost, scalability, and operational requirements.
  • Troubleshoots complex networking and communications issues across multiple technology stacks.
  • Provides technical leadership for connectivity platform development.

Software Product Design / Architecture

  • Demonstrates experience designing large-scale distributed systems and connectivity platforms.
  • Understands architectural patterns supporting edge-to-cloud communications.
  • Leads architecture reviews and technical design discussions.
  • Evaluates tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, security, and scalability.
  • Guides implementation of reusable and maintainable software solutions.

Cloud & Data Pipeline Engineering

Designs telemetry ingestion, processing, and data distribution architectures.

  • Develops solutions supporting real-time and batch data processing.
  • Understands event-driven systems, streaming platforms, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Collaborates with enterprise data teams to ensure high-quality data delivery and observability.
  • Optimizes data flows between machines, edge devices, and cloud systems.

Technical Excellence

  • Provides innovative solutions to challenging technical problems.
  • Maintains expertise in current and emerging technologies.
  • Applies engineering standards and best practices to solution development.
  • Leads technical reviews and provides guidance to development teams.
  • Serves as a technical resource for complex system integration efforts.

Strategic Thinking

  • Understands Connectivity organization objectives and technical priorities.
  • Identifies technology trends and opportunities impacting future platform capabilities.
  • Contributes recommendations supporting long-term technology strategy.
  • Evaluates technical alternatives against business and customer outcomes.
  • Understands ecosystem impacts beyond immediate project scope.

Influencing Through Expertise

  • Builds credibility through strong technical leadership and execution.
  • Influences engineering decisions through technical expertise and analysis.
  • Presents recommendations supported by technical evidence and operational data.
  • Mentors team members and promotes engineering excellence.
  • Collaborates effectively across engineering disciplines and stakeholder groups.

Communicating Complex Concepts

  • Creates technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and design reviews.

    • Private LTE or Private 5G environments
    • Telematics platforms and connected assets
    • Edge computing solutions

    • IoT device management and telemetry systems
  • Experience designing and supporting large-scale data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with autonomous systems, remote operations, and industrial IoT environments.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex technical initiatives and mentoring engineering teams.

title: Associate Director, Strategic Communications and Organizational Engagement, Remote
description:
Job Description

The Associate Director, Organizational Engagement reports to the Chief of Staff (CoS) of the Senior Vice President (SVP)of Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO) and plays a key role in shaping and executing the strategic communications for GCTO’s global workforce of over 10,000 employees. Serves as strategic advisor to the GCTO leadership team, this role is responsible for developing and implementing enterprise-wide communication strategies that enhance organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and change readiness across a highly matrixed and regulated environment.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with deep expertise in strategic communications, change management, cross-functional and workforce engagement with exceptional digital acumen skills, including the responsible use of AI.

This role engages with the SVP, GCTO and the leadership team as a strategic partner and advisor, develops engagement and change management strategies in alignment with GCTO’s strategic priorities, goals and branding guidelines Responsible for the development and maintenance of GCTO’s communications framework; supports planning and delivery of GCTO events; and serves as a day-to-day partner to GCTO leaders to support internal messaging, executive communications, and presentation materials.

Responsibilities:

Executive Engagement and Advisory

  • Serves as a strategic communications partner to GCTO leadership, crafting executive-level messaging that drives clarity, alignment, and action.
  • Diagnosing communication gaps and design interventions that enhance leadership visibility and effectiveness

Strategic Communications Leadership

  • Develops, plans, and executes the global engagement and internal communications strategy for GCTO ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and communication guidelines. Collaborates with the GCTO leadership team, GCTO’s and GCD’s Project Management Office (PMO) in the development of communications for special initiatives.
  • Manages vendor relationships and deliverables to ensure quality, timeliness and alignment with GCTO communication objectives. Develops and executes the GCTO enterprise employee engagement strategy, designing and leading engagement initiatives including surveys, listening strategies, and action planning; analyzing feedback data and translating findings into actionable insights and recommendations for GCTO leadership
  • Measures effectiveness of engagement and communication activities through established metrics and recommend improvements to increase employee understanding, engagement and adoption.

Communication Framework, Content Channels & Brand Consistency

  • Develops and maintains the GCTO communications framework and toolkit to drive efficient, high quality communications
  • Develops and maximizes fit-for-purpose GCTO communication channels to drive targeted information distribution, consumption, and uptake.
  • Maximizes effectiveness of communications campaigns and channels leveraging data-centric measurement plans and stakeholder feedback; synthesizes insights and recommends improvement to communication strategies (ex. frequency and format).
  • Ensures communications are developed consistent with GCTO and company branding guidelines.
  • Translates complex scientific, technical and business concepts into clear, concise and compelling narratives for different stakeholder audiences.

Events, Engagement, & Knowledge Sharing

  • Supports planning and execution of major GCTO events (e.g., town halls, leadership messaging, large meetings, senior leader updates including narrative arcs, visuals, SharePoint and engagement mechanics.
  • Provides ad hoc support as relevant (e.g., industry presentation consultation; onboarding communications, intern events).

Leadership Communications & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serves as day-to-day partner to GCTO leadership team on internal messaging; drafts and refines executive communications and presentation materials
  • Develops and delivers structured communication plans for major GCTO change initiatives ensuring messaging reinforces adoption objectives throughout each initiative lifecycle
  • Ensures alignment across training, communications, and leadership messaging for major initiatives
  • Acts as a reliable partner to GCTO and other cross-functional teams, actively seeking input, aligning on priorities, and closing feedback loops to drive high-quality, coordinated engagement and communications.

Qualifications, Skills, Experience and Education:

Technical Skills:

  • Ability to translate technical and scientific subject matter and content into clear narratives for target audiences
  • Advanced skills in SharePoint Online administration and page design; governance of content hubs and basic HTML/UX
  • Experience working with enterprise communications tools (e.g., email/newsletter platforms, survey tools, asset libraries); template creation and governance
  • Expertise in interpreting campaign/channel analytics (e.g., email, SharePoint, Teams/Viva Engage); ability to compile metrics into simple dashboards
  • Deep knowledge of internal communications controls (privacy, accessibility, records retention) and brand/tone standards
  • Experience in applying project management tools and methods to enhance overall effectiveness
  • Experience in and advanced knowledge of the responsible use of AI to enable effective communications with human in the lead oversight.
  • Demonstrates working proficiency with enterprise-approved digital, data, and AI tools relevant to the role; applies automation and data-driven approaches in day-to-day work.
  • Certification Standard: Holds and maintains GCTO Elevate – Beginner (minimum) within first 6 months in role; progresses to role-appropriate tier annually

Preferred:

  • Experience in service provider and production management across design, video, events, and content operations

Non-Technical Skills:

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to drive content creation and delivery across a broad range of stakeholders (e.g., executive, organizational, geography-specific, and functional)
  • Customer and stakeholder mindset with experience in coordinating and coaching content authors with a focus on clarity, quality, tone, and compliance
  • Experience coordinating teams, partnering across the organization, leading decision making, and delivering results without positional or program authority undefined

Enterprise Leadership Skills:

  • Business Savviness - Uses organization and industry information to identify trends, assess current business practices and results, and/or evaluate specific function/operation changes and anticipate their impact
  • Strategic Planning - Identifies more critical and less critical activities and assignments; adjusts priorities when appropriate.
  • Execution Excellence - Takes action that goes beyond job requirements to achieve results
  • Influence - Clearly communicates the benefits of an idea, proposal, or approach (for the individual, team, and organization); tailors the persuasion strategy to engage individuals emotionally and rationally; leverages supporting evidence to address anticipated objections; summarizes benefits to ensure understanding

Qualifications & experience:

  • Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 8 years of experience working in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, clinical trial operations, operations, or relevant field.

OR

  • Advanced degree (Masters or Doctorate) with a minimum of 4 years of experience working in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, data management, clinical trial operations, operations, or relevant field
  • A minimum of 3 years overseeing communication planning in a global, matrixed organization is required

title: Director, Applied Science (Responsible AI/Multimodal)
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking a Director of Applied Science to lead the Responsible AI Applied Science team. This leader will define and execute the scientific and technical strategy for building the next generation of Responsible AI technologies that enable customers to safely and reliably deploy multimodal generative AI models and agentic systems at enterprise scale.


The Responsible AI Applied Science team advances research and develops cutting-edge technologies for guardrailing multimodal generative AI models and AI agents. The team's work spans models and applications that reason over and generate across modalities—including text, images, audio, video, and combinations of these modalities. Research areas include content safety and moderation, prompt injection and adversarial attacks, privacy and PII protection, hallucination and grounding, reliability, formal verification, and emerging approaches for governing and constraining agent behavior.
As generative AI becomes increasingly multimodal, safety challenges extend beyond individual prompts and responses to the interactions between modalities, models, tools, and agents. The team develops new techniques for understanding and mitigating these risks while building guardrails that can operate effectively across diverse models, modalities, and enterprise use cases.

This is a senior scientific leadership role at the intersection of research, product, and engineering. The Director will lead a team of applied scientists, establish the team's research and product roadmap, and translate advances in multimodal Responsible AI into differentiated capabilities for OCI customers. The successful candidate will balance breakthrough research with pragmatic execution, ensuring the team's work results in production technologies, high-impact publications, patents, and meaningful advances in the state of the art.

What You'll Do

Set the Responsible AI Science Strategy

  • Define the Applied Science roadmap for multimodal Responsible AI in OCI, identifying the highest-impact scientific and customer problems for the team to pursue.
  • Establish priorities across near-term production deliverables and longer-term breakthrough research.
  • Develop a research agenda for guardrailing generative AI across text, vision, audio, video, multimodal models, and agentic systems.
  • Anticipate emerging risks and technical challenges as generative AI evolves from single-modality models toward increasingly multimodal, autonomous, tool-using, and agentic systems.
  • Partner closely with Applied Science Architects, the Chief Scientist, engineering leaders, and product leadership to identify and invest in breakthrough science opportunities that can create differentiated capabilities for OCI.

Lead a High-Performing Applied Science Team

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of applied scientists working across Responsible AI, multimodal AI safety, and AI reliability.
  • Establish a culture of scientific rigor, technical ambition, experimentation, collaboration, and customer impact.
  • Provide technical and scientific direction while enabling senior scientists to independently lead significant research areas.
  • Attract and develop exceptional scientific talent and build the capabilities required as the Responsible AI and multimodal AI landscapes evolve.

Advance the State of the Art in Multimodal Responsible AI

Drive research and innovation across areas including:

  • Multimodal content safety, moderation, and policy enforcement across text, image, audio, and video
  • Multimodal prompt injection, jailbreaks, and adversarial robustness
  • Privacy, PII, and sensitive-information detection and protection across modalities
  • Hallucination, grounding, and factuality detection and mitigation
  • Safety and reliability of multimodal foundation models
  • Cross-modal safety, including risks that emerge from interactions between different input and output modalities
  • Formal methods and verification for AI systems
  • Evaluation, benchmarking, and measurement of Responsible AI systems across models and modalities
  • Guardrails for AI agents, including tool use, planning, actions, multimodal inputs and outputs, and multi-agent behavior
  • Novel approaches to runtime monitoring, intervention, and enforcement for multimodal generative AI systems

Identify opportunities where advances in these areas can become production capabilities, publications, patents, or strategic intellectual property for Oracle.

Translate Research into Customer Value

  • Work closely with engineering, product management, and other OCI stakeholders to productionize Responsible AI research into scalable multimodal guardrails and services.
  • Develop a deep understanding of enterprise customer requirements and translate them into meaningful scientific and technical problems.
  • Build guardrail technologies that can operate across different generative AI models and modalities while supporting diverse enterprise applications.
  • Ensure Responsible AI technologies meet the performance, scalability, latency, reliability, and security requirements of OCI production environments.
  • Define metrics and evaluation frameworks that measure safety and reliability across modalities and demonstrate both scientific progress and measurable customer value.
  • Help establish OCI as a trusted platform for enterprises deploying multimodal generative AI and agentic applications.

Provide Scientific and Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical authority for multimodal Responsible AI across OCI.
  • Communicate complex scientific topics, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities to technical and executive audiences.
  • Build strong partnerships across Applied Science, Engineering, Product, Security, and other organizations within Oracle.
  • Represent Oracle's Responsible AI research through publications, patents, external scientific engagement, and collaboration with the broader research community where appropriate.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research and industry experience.
  • Significant experience leading applied science or machine learning research teams working on complex, ambiguous technical problems.
  • Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision, multimodal learning, or related areas, with strong familiarity with modern foundation models.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate research innovations into production systems or customer-facing technologies.
  • Strong scientific track record demonstrated through publications, patents, deployed technologies, or other significant technical contributions.
  • Experience defining research roadmaps and making investment and prioritization decisions across multiple scientific areas.
  • Ability to operate effectively across research, engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries.

Preferred

  • Expertise in one or more Responsible AI areas such as multimodal AI safety, model guardrails, adversarial robustness, content moderation, privacy, hallucination and grounding, model evaluation, formal verification, or AI agent safety.
  • Experience working with multimodal foundation models, including vision-language models and models spanning text, image, audio, or video.
  • Experience developing safety, security, or reliability technologies for large-scale AI systems.
  • Experience with multimodal model evaluation, red teaming, adversarial testing, or runtime AI safety mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with emerging challenges associated with AI agents, including tool-use safety, action validation, behavioral constraints, multimodal interactions, and agent monitoring.
  • Experience building or operating AI/ML technologies in large-scale cloud environments.
  • A track record of identifying emerging research areas and translating them into differentiated products or intellectual property.

What Success Looks Like

The Director of Applied Science will build a Responsible AI organization recognized for both scientific excellence and production impact, with a particular focus on making the rapidly evolving world of multimodal generative AI safer, more reliable, and enterprise-ready.

Success will mean establishing an ambitious research agenda for guardrailing models across modalities, developing exceptional scientists, delivering multimodal guardrails that provide tangible value to OCI customers, and creating breakthrough technologies that strengthen Oracle's position in safe and reliable enterprise AI.

The team's impact should be visible across three dimensions: production, through Responsible AI capabilities deployed for customers across models and modalities; scientific leadership, through influential research and publications; and innovation, through patents and differentiated technology that expands what is possible in trustworthy multimodal generative AI and agentic systems.

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
description:
This Nuclear Medicine Technologist position is assigned to the Tennessee Valley Healthcare System, Medical Imaging Service in the Nuclear Medicine program. TVHS is a 1a complexity facility that provides services in specialized and complex areas of diagnostic imaging and a comprehensive Nuclear Medicine program. The Nuclear Medicine Technologist employed at this level is fully functional as an Advanced Nuclear Medicine Technologist and is able to cany out the assigned tasks independently.

This specialty modality requires specific knowledgeable that technologists require expert specialization in complex areas of Nuclear Medicine. These technologists are heavily relied upon by interpreting physicians and radiologists to provide diagnostic aid by conducting appropriate organ or body scans during complex procedures, administer and record radiopharmaceuticals in accordance with protocols and report any abnormal activity. Nuclear Medicine technologists at TVHS are required to maintain in depth knowledge of complex nuclear medicine equipment/supplies and be capable of using during significantly complex imaging procedures. The technologist requires specific knowledge and training in the positioning, pathology appearance, and function of the complex organ or vascular systems to nuclear illumination; ability to interpret examination request accurately; ability to use the various methods and techniques which will identify areas of interest appearing on the display for radiologist interpretation; and the ability to judge the acceptability of the image and/or scan for diagnostic use and to emphasize the aspects of particular interest to the interpreting physician. Duties include but not limited to: Accurately operates a wide variety of imaging equipment to obtain examinations of acceptable quality, utilizing the least amount of radiation to obtain quality images that meet established protocols. Performs a wide variety of physiologic studies of the human body using a variety of isotopes and compounds. Must understand the normal and abnormal bio-distribution of the radiopharmaceutical used The types of exams performed are: Dynamic vascular flow imaging followed by blood pool and delayed SPECT/CT. Tc99m and Tl201 Gated Cardiac perfusion, Tc99m tagged Multi-gated cardiac, Infection scans, simple renal scans, renal scans using Lasix, renal scans using captopril, Lung scans (VQ, Quants), Liver/spleen, I 123 DAT scan (Parkinson's) Gastric studies, CSF shunt studies, peritoneal dialysis leak studies, etc. Possess expert specialization in complex areas of nuclear medicine and may provide after hours on-call coverage at TVHS. Required to maintain in depth knowledge of complex diagnostic and interventional cardiovascular equipment/supplies and be capable of assisting with their use during significantly complex imaging procedures. Troubleshoot camera equipment and computer problems that may occur to ensure patients receive a quality exam. Perform quality assurance assessments and improvement programs, develop team dynamics and teamwork with both interpreting physicians and physician's assistants. Utilizes specialized knowledge of all technical duties and responsibilities during each procedure to provide a timely well-organized exam and patient experience. The Nuclear Medicine technologists are required to document patient's clinical history on correct forms to provide clinical information, order, stock and prepare the NM suites, for each procedure, to ensure that all necessary supplies and equipment are readily available and in optimal working condition. Serves as a clinical instructor to the students. Sphere of responsibilities include providing the students with the appropriate and adequate clinical instruction/supervision, evaluating the student's clinical performance/competence, and critique the student's radiographic studies. All technologists must work, interact, grade, and be essential in their learning process. Work in the radio pharmacy assaying, drawing, and administering radiopharmaceuticals in Nuclear Medicine. Responsible for clinical, research, and educational duties in the program and works closely with radiologists, clinicians, radiology nurses, and trainees to ensure optimum quality control, coordination of activities, and that high quality diagnostic imaging results are achieved. Work Schedule: Days (with rotating call) Telework: Not Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Weight Management Program and Bariatric Nutrition) coordinate nutritional care of Veterans with other health care providers, the Veteran, the Veteran's caregiver, and the community. Clinical Dietitians collaborate with the Food Operations Section to enhance the Veterans' dining experience and ensure patient satisfaction.

title: Clinical Research Budget Analyst
description:
The Clinical Research Budget Analyst (CRBA) is responsible for the calendar build and development of medium to high complexity Coverage Analyses (CA) and the maintenance and update of the coverage determinations for protocol amendments. The position is responsible for the development and negotiation of budgets for clinical research studies regardless of funding source, including industry sponsors, grants, awards, fellowships, cooperatives, etc. This position captures all administrative fees, items and services, and investigator and study team efforts required to carry out the study. The incumbent will be responsible for developing an internal cost budget to inform budget negotiation and ensure all costs are captured in the final sponsor budget. This role will provide guidance to junior colleagues and serve as an expert resource for the research community as well as to define and improve workflows. The incumbent will leverage current and future Seattle Children's systems, such as a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), to support pre-award activities.

Note: This is a remote position with flexibility to be based in the following states: Washington, Alaska, Montana, Georgia, and Florida. The salary range shown is for Washington and Alaska only.

Required Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in biology and other health sciences or financial/business administration field (Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or similar); or associate degree and relevant certifications (including, but not limited to RHIT, RHIA, CPC, Coverage Analysis, etc.) OR equivalent experience.
  • Minimum four (4) years' experience in development, negotiation, management, reconciliation, and/or review of clinical trial budgets and/or coverage analysis.

Preferred:

- CPT Coding Certificate.

  • Experience developing budgets for industry-funded trials.
  • Experience negotiating clinical trial budgets with industry sponsors.
  • Experience in using a Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).
  • Working experience in utilizing CPT codes in the process of development of

clinical trial budgets.

$73,378.00 - $146,497.00 per year

Job Description:

bp supply, trading & shipping graduate programme – Singapore (January 2027 start)

About bp

As a leading global energy company with a presence in 61 countries, bp’s purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. We are one of only a few companies that can deliver energy – at scale – to countries and millions of customers every day. With more than 100 years of experience, we bring together technology, innovation and deep expertise that keeps communities moving – and we’re still evolving.

About early careers

Early careers opportunities

Your talent. Your skills. Your big ideas (and even bigger dreams). We know you have a lot to give. So we’ll make sure you get a lot in return. From next-level experiences to global impact. From inspiring teammates to exceptional support – we offer graduate and internship roles across multiple areas.

Our supply, trading & shipping graduate programme

Fast-moving. High impact. Full of possibility. In supply, trading & shipping (ST&S), every decision matters – and you’ll be making them sooner than you think.

Why work in ST&S at bp?

  • Play a role in powering economies worldwide.

  • Work in a fast-paced environment where every second counts.

  • Build future-proof skills that open up many different career paths.

  • Learn from experienced teams who’ll help you grow your commercial confidence.

As an ST&S graduate, you’ll complete three rotations designed to give you breadth of experience across your chosen business area while also supporting you to build technical depth. From analysing data to influencing decision making, to building customer relationships and shaping deals – this programme gives you the exposure and experience to start building a future in commercial business.

Join us and you’ll get the support of a structured technical pathway and our training programme, helping you grow both professionally and personally. In return, you'll bring your ideas, curiosity and ambition to real business challenges. Along the way, you'll be part of a supportive bp early careers community that will help you grow, succeed and make a meaningful impact from day one.

We’re recruiting for graduates to join us on the Trading and Analytics track for a January 2027 start.

Trading development track: Joining our energy trading team, you’ll be part of managing our trades on all of the major energy commodity exchanges and the OTC market as well as our daily exposure. You'll have the opportunity to experience different trading disciplines and styles from physical trading to paper trading. Over the course of the 3-year graduate scheme, you'll complete rotations that equip you with the skills and knowledge to become a successful trader at the end of the programme. Rotations may include market analytics, physical operations or working as a trading analyst on one of our trading benches.

Analytics development track: Analysts have the opportunity to directly influence the bottom line as part of a highly commercial and skilled team. Working in the fast-paced world of our trading floors and with access to vast amounts of data and information, you’ll focus on driving continued growth in trading profits and acting as a subject matter expert on energy market fundamentals.

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Demand Intergrations) (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Running the Engine Behind 200M+ Daily Ad Decisions

Behind every ad decision at adjoe is a system designed to operate at massive scale, serving more than 770 million mobile users every year. The Demand API Integrations team owns the systems that connect our platform to the global adtech ecosystem, handling over 5.5 billion API requests daily across installs, events, views, clicks, and postbacks from Mobile Measurement Partners.

We operate a dedicated A/B testing environment against live traffic to validate system behavior under real-world conditions, allowing us to evaluate advertiser integrations, benchmark partner performance, and verify attribution accuracy end-to-end before deploying globally.

We integrate TensorFlow-based ML models to predict user engagement and purchase likelihood, directly influencing real-time ad distribution. To meet our strict 100ms latency constraint, we prioritize efficient model serving, low-latency data access, and deliberate system design.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years in Go, built for scale. You have 3+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.

  • Distributed systems are your default context. You design and operate microservice architectures using Kafka and SQS/SNS for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into Kafka streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.

  • Data performance matters at every layer. You work with Druid, MySQL, Redis, and DynamoDB, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.

  • Bridge product and Data Science. You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production-ready backend services.

  • Partner-facing data ownership. You support partners through well-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.

  • Infrastructure fluency is part of the job. You have hands-on experience with Terraform, Docker, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end-to-end from development to production.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Sr. UX Designer
description:
The highly competitive US generic pharmaceutical sector continues to challenge every element of the supply chain. In this constantly changing environment, patients can be served through multiple channels in new & different ways, whilst those that dispense prescriptions, the wholesale distributors that supply them and manufacturers all have to react and respond to how the sector is evolving, which is also heavily influenced by payers, regulatory bodies and federal & state law. To succeed in this environment requires organisations to adapt and change and, at ClarusONE, we play a key role in working alongside multiple stakeholders to deliver the most efficient supply chain model whilst generating value for our Members, their customers and patients through innovative sourcing solutions.

The ClarusONE proprietary sourcing platform is key to enabling innovation across the sourcing model. The purpose of this role is to ensure that the strategic product delivery team builds technology solutions that genuinely meet the needs of the differing user groups of this platform. Working alongside the product managers, this role is key to shaping the product direction by commissioning and managing dedicated user research which, via user journeys, delivers a clear set of design requirements. In addition, this role acts as the ‘voice of the user’, providing insights into user behaviours, pain points, and expectations, making sure that development decisions are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Owns the quantitative research programmes used to understand user needs, behaviours, and pain points, utilising methods such as interviews, surveys, and observations to gather insights that guide product direction and ensure user‑centred decision‑making.

  • Responsible for generating the wireframes, user flows, and prototypes that translate the research findings into intuitive digital experiences. This means ensuring all product and/or feature designs follow usability principles, accessibility standards, and align with the overall product vision.

  • As part of the wider digital and data science roadmap, will lead the design of user experiences in the software that enable machine learning and AI powered features.

  • Will own the planning and execution of usability tests to retrospectively evaluate design effectiveness and identify areas for future improvement.

  • Will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, and UI designers to ensure that user experience requirements are clearly defined, technically feasible, and accurately implemented throughout the development process.

  • Owns the ongoing production of UX documentation, design specifications, journey maps, and research summaries.

  • Alongside the Director, Strategic Product Delivery, will regularly communicate to a variety of stakeholders, promoting design rationale and advocating for user‑centred practices across the organisation.

Minimum Requirement

Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

Critical Skills

  • Proven experience conducting user research using interviews, surveys, observational studies, and usability evaluations

  • Strong ability to translate research insights into personas, journey maps, and actionable design recommendations

  • Hands-on experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and user flows using tools such as Figma

  • Solid understanding of UX design principles, usability heuristics, and accessibility standards

  • Demonstrated ability to run usability tests, analyse results, and iterate designs based on evidence

  • Experience collaborating with product managers, developers, and UI designers in agile or cross‑functional teams

Additional Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong communication skills for presenting research findings, design rationale, and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Ability to work with data analytics (e.g., heatmaps, behavioural analytics, conversion metrics) to support UX decisions.

  • Familiarity with information architecture, content structure, and interaction patterns across digital platforms.

  • Familiar with the implementation of AI and machine learning applications within a software platform, including relevant efficacy testing, oversight and governance requirements and familiarity with Sketch, or Adobe XD

  • Problem‑solving mindset with the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business objectives.

title: Sr. CMF Designer
description:
Job Description:

The Sr. CMF Designer is responsible for following up with local engineering teams and manufacturers to accurately implement the original color, material and finish design intent of Belkin's products. The role is based in Belkin’s Shenzhen, China office, and collaborates closely with our talented local design team and is in on-going communication with the US-based Innovation Design Group (Playa Vista, California). The Sr. CMF Designer is responsible for communication and creative exploration of various methods and strategies to achieve the results needed to follow design intent, and balances it against quality requirements, budget and schedule. Among other areas, specific areas of focus are plastics textures, color matching, painting, metal anodizing, PVD, identifying appropriate materials and graphic applications (e.g. laser, printing, labeling). The Sr. CMF Designer is responsible to help identify new materials, new decoration processes as necessary for each project and to communicate them to the international design and engineering teams for project application. In addition, the Sr. CMF Designer helps to expertly resolve challenging design details by producing prototypes samples, and finally reviewing and approving parts or whole products for production. To achieve this, you will be working closely with Belkin's Playa Vista Industrial Designers, Product Managers, Program Managers, Engineers, the Procurement team, and various local manufacturers and vendors. The Sr. CMF Designer must strive to learn new things, be comfortable with going outside of their comfort zone, and enjoy solving problems while maintaining a positive-active attitude. They must be able to effectively communicate ideas across the globe, to bring alignment through strong verbal and written English and Chinese communication as well as using sketches, renderings, and digital presentations. The Sr. CMF Designer must be able to analyze and translate Product Requirements into an executable CMF design that provides best solutions to the end-user and to the business. The goal is to achieve 5-star user reviews while product cost target, development schedule, and product quality target are met. The Sr. CMF Designer is expected to frequently travel to manufacturing sites, and occasionally visit the US headquarters.

Specific responsibilities:

  • Collaborate proactively with US Industrial Design team to understand design intent and goals
  • Communicate CMF design intent through CMF design, specifications, and master samples to engineering staff and manufacturers
  • Study concepts with Engineers and Suppliers and make necessary feasibility negotiation while protecting the original design intent
  • Make sketches, 2D, or 3D design changes to the original concepts and counter propose options to Industrial Designers if needed
  • Research CMF and develop strategic and tactical solutions as required. Present reports and materials to inspire the rest of the design organization
  • Develop various levels of prototypes, including proof of concept, form & style samples, aesthetic samples, and even working samples as needed
  • Gather and provide comparison data for multiple CMF design options against cost, schedule, quality, and other critical attributes and lead the cross-functional team to achieve consensus
  • On ODM projects, provide CMF design guideline to ODM designers, review, and approve their work in collaboration with US ID team
  • Work with Sourcing team to identify new suppliers as needed for project purposes
  • Generate and manage measurable CMF, and other cosmetic specifications
  • Review and approve parts/product for production
  • Adhere to the project budgets and timelines as set by the Program Manager
  • Adhere to Belkin’s brand & design language guidelines

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in Industrial Design or Engineering related field.
  • 6+ years of design experience in the consumer product industry
  • 4+ years of CMF design and management experience
  • Fluent in relevant software (Adobe CC, SolidWorks CAD, MS Office, etc.), tools, materials (from consumer electronics to fashion), and manufacturing processes
  • Highly proficient in use of Adobe CS 5, Excel, PowerPoint software
  • 3D CAD modeling experience using SolidWorks, Pro-E, or Rhino highly preferred
  • Knowledge of color theory, ability to analyze and make comments efficiently to suppliers
  • Knowledge of CMF related specification methods and measurement techniques
  • Knowledge of CMF related measurement tools, such as spectrophotometer, glossmeter, etc.
  • Knowledge of various CMF application processes (PVD, dyeing, silk screening, spraying, etc.)
  • Ability to multi-task in tight timelines with an exceptional eye for details
  • Substantial interest in consumer and industry trends
  • Excellent visual communication and presentation skills
  • Excellent verbal and written English and Mandarin skills
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally

What you’re getting into


We’ve got big collaborative spaces for your big ideas, so bring an open mind and leave your suit in the closet. We all are committed to creating unique and rewarding consumer experiences. Everyone is interested in succeeding – for the team, for themselves and for the business. Cross-functionally and across the company, everyone has common goals and aspires to be their best.


You will learn something new or at least look at things differently every day. There are so many smart and creative people around that you’ll be motivated to pursue the ideal.


Team spirit is infectious. Belkin is an extremely open workplace, where communication is essential. Not every idea will be accepted, but you’ll be asked for your point of view. Innovation thrives on multiple and varied levels. At Belkin we challenge conventional wisdom and refuse to accept that something cannot be done.

title: CFSD Administrative Officer
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Arlington County requires all applicants to thoroughly complete each section of the application, including prior job responsibilities, duties, and supplemental questions. While you may attach a resume, it will not replace a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

The Child and Family Services Division (CFSD) of the Department of Human Services (DHS) is seeking an Administrative Officer with strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with system partners to monitor and administer a budget of almost $25 million. The Administrative Officer is a critical senior leadership position responsible for fiscal stewardship and resource allocation to support an effective service delivery system for children and families.

The Administrative Officer is responsible for monitoring and coordinating all financial processes, human resources, procurement, and general administrative functions for CFSD. This incumbent will lead and manage the work of 8 financial and administrative staff and provide direct supervision to four staff. A primary focus of this position is extensive management analysis in support of the Division’s mission to provide excellent innovative services that promote safety, protect children, and preserve and strengthen families.

Specific duties include:

  • Directing budget formulation, financial management, and procurement processes to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations;
  • Monitoring program audits and grants management;
  • Tracking personnel transactions and expenditures to support revenue maximization and monitor state-reimbursable positions;
  • Reconciling accounts and initiating journal entries, budget revisions, and other fiscal adjustments;
  • Supervising staff directly and indirectly, including hiring, training, assigning work, evaluating performance, and coordinating disciplinary actions;
  • Managing contracts by writing specifications, negotiating pricing, monitoring performance, and evaluating program effectiveness;
  • Leading the development and oversight of Children’s Services Act (CSA) programming across multiple child-serving agencies;
  • Participating as a senior leader on Family Assessment and Planning and Community Management and Planning Teams;
  • Developing policies, procedures, and performance measurement systems to support quality improvement, board reporting, and compliance initiatives; and
  • Collaborating with DHS stakeholders and senior management to guide strategic planning, training, and cross-agency coordination for children and family services.

Arlington County DHS is committed to delivering client services in an effective, equitable, respectful, and trauma-informed manner. Our staff is dedicated to ensuring our clients are approached, engaged and cared for in ways that demonstrate competency, sensitivity and awareness of factors which impact the client experience. This includes but is not limited to: cultural identity, gender, racial, and ethnic diversity, religious/spiritual ascription, physical capability, cognitive and literacy levels, sexual orientation, and linguistic needs.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business/Public Administration or related field; and
  • Significant and progressively responsible full-time experience in program administration and/or management, which includes budget development and analysis, and/or reconciliation of accounts, and other administrative functions such as Human Resources, Procurement, program planning, grants management, and/or contracts management.

Substitution: Additional education may be substituted for experience. Additional experience may be substituted for education.

Desirable: Preference may be given to candidates with experience or proficiency in one or more of the following:

  • Policy analysis, program evaluation, and performance measurement;
  • Navigating local government programs involving State and Federal funding and associated accountability;
  • Software tools including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and presentation platforms; and/or
  • Interpreting procurement regulations, managing HR policies or systems, and coordinating cross-functional teams or stakeholders.

Special Requirements

Background Check: A pre-employment criminal records check will be conducted. It will include checks of the following: criminal record, driving record, education, professional licensure, and credit history. You will be required to sign a release authorizing the County to obtain your background information.

Driver’s License: The applicant must possess, or obtain by the time of appointment, a valid motor vehicle operator's license from the applicant's place of residence or commit to utilizing alternate means of transportation to perform assigned duties and responsibilities at locations other than the primary worksite. If the applicant possesses or acquires a license, the applicant must authorize Arlington County to obtain, or the applicant must provide a copy of the applicant's official state/district driving record. Any offer of employment may be contingent upon a favorable review of the applicant's driving record.[WJ1.1]

Additional Information

Work Hours: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm., Monday through Friday with occasional evening meetings scheduled in advance and weekend preparation. Some telework is available.

The official title of this position is Administrative Officer (DHS).

Please complete each section of the application including the supplemental questions. Your responses to the supplemental questions are required because they provide us with specific information necessary to evaluate your qualifications for this position. These responses are considered part of the selection process. A resume may be attached; however, it will not substitute for a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please do not write "see resume" as a response to the questions. In accordance with § 19.2-392.15, applicants are not required to provide information regarding sealed arrests, charges, or convictions in response to any questions or inquiries during the hiring process.

This position is eligible for County government employee benefits that include health, dental, vacation and sick leave, commuter transportation subsidies, tuition reimbursement, as well as a generous retirement plan.

For more information on Arlington County’s generous benefits and retirement plan, click here.

Arlington County is committed to advancing diversity, equity, access, and inclusion across all our services, activities, and programs. Learn more about our commitment.

You will collaborate closely with engineers across the world, contribute to design discussions, and help evolve PlayReady’s architecture to meet current and future security, compliance, and partner requirements.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile
description:
• Build the Android experiences used by millions of people

  • Shape the future of mobile at REA, influencing architecture, mentoring engineers and helping move a major app from monolith to micro-frontends

  • Join a permanent Senior Engineer (Mobile Android) role based in Melbourne, with the flexibility to work across mobile, web and the wider technology stack

We're REA
With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.

Where the team fits in

The Listing Experience Squad sits within the Residential Advertising Value product group. We own the property details experience across web, iOS and Android — helping property seekers evaluate and act on properties from page view to offer.

Our work includes media viewers, tours, property highlights, calculators and integrations with the Listing Experience API. We’re a full-stack team of around five to six engineers, working across mobile, web and backend.

What the role is all about

As a Senior Engineer (Mobile Android), you’ll help build and evolve REA’s mobile products, with Android as your speciality. You’ll remain hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring developers and influencing mobile architecture and engineering practices.

You’ll work with product, design and engineering colleagues to deliver robust, maintainable and high-performing experiences. While Android is your primary focus, you’ll have the flexibility to contribute across APIs, cloud services, delivery pipelines, iOS and web when needed.

Day to day, you’ll:

  • Design, build, test and document Android applications and supporting services using REA Engineering standards

  • Lead or contribute to high-value initiatives and deliver features from discovery through to deployment and optimisation

  • Solve complex technical problems and share your knowledge to lift team capability

  • Guide technical decisions, architecture and engineering practices in partnership with the Engineering Manager and senior engineers

  • Work with stakeholders to design high-quality solutions that meet user needs

  • Maintain existing products, resolve production issues and participate in the Day Pager Primary roster

  • Own your code through production, with responsibility for reliability, security and performance

  • Connect with REA’s mobile community and contribute to team culture, recruitment and continuous improvement

Who we’re looking for

You’re a Senior Android engineer who can work independently, make sound technical decisions and contribute confidently in a collaborative environment.

You’ll bring:

  • Extensive Android development experience and strong Kotlin skills

  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable, high-performance mobile applications and supporting services

  • Strong knowledge of mobile architecture, API integration, platform guidelines and performance optimisation

  • The ability to deliver significant features end-to-end and work across the stack when needed

  • Sound judgement around technical patterns and trade-offs, with the confidence to explain and defend your recommendations

  • A collaborative approach to technical debate, including openness to feedback and correction

  • A genuine interest in mentoring, teaching and helping others grow

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex ideas into clear plans

  • Experience working in an Agile environment with a focus on quality and user experience

  • A track record of resolving production issues effectively

  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Copilot and Codex

Our tech stack and ways of working

  • Agile, cross-functional delivery across web and native product experiences

  • Mobile applications, APIs, cloud services and delivery pipelines

  • A “you build it, you run it” approach to reliability, security and performance

  • A tight-knit mobile community focused on knowledge sharing, pairing, mentoring and architecture

  • A multi-year initiative to retire the legacy monolith and adopt micro-frontend patterns

  • Thoughtful use of AI tools to improve efficiency and development practices

  • A strong focus on engagement, wellbeing and psychological safety

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working

  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave

  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers

  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity

  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Join our Talent Neighbourhood

Keen to be part of REA but didn't find a perfect match with this opportunity? Perhaps the timing isn't right? You should join our Talent Neighbourhood!

Job Description:

At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the project’s life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.
  • Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.
  • Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).
  • Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.
  • Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.
  • Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.
  • Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.

Your background

  • Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects
  • Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

description:
Trade Counter Assistant - Plumbing Auckland

About Reece New Zealand

Reece Group is a proud 100+ year old company whose journey in Aotearoa began 20 years ago with a vision to become the most respected industry supplier in New Zealand. Our people have helped us achieve great results throughout these years and we want you to be a part of this journey.

At Reece, we invest in our people so you'll receive ongoing training - plus have opportunities to advance in the business. Here, you'll have a future you can feel good about.

About the role

As part of the Trade Counter team (Branch Staff) in Auckland, you’ll help plumbers and other tradespeople access the products they need for building and renovation projects and undertake other tasks that keep the branch running smoothly.

Your day-to-day

A typical day involves:

  • Providing customer service and information about products

  • Make regular deliveries to customers using a company vehicle

  • Providing quotes both in person and over the phone

  • Undertaking pick packing and stock control activities

At Reece Group, we prioritize fairness and are here to support you at every step. If you need any accommodations, let us know so we can provide the best support. Contact us at recruitment@reece.com.au and our team will be in touch.

Reece Group

title: Analyst – Investment Performance and Regulatory Reporting
description:
Company:

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Investment Performance and Regulatory Reporting team at Mercer. This role will be based in Melbourne OR Sydney. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. This opportunity is offered on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

The Analyst – Investment Performance and Regulatory Reporting is responsible for collating and maintaining key performance-based datasets, supporting the team to produce accurate and timely investment reports. This role sits at the intersection of investment performance and regulatory compliance, providing critical data insights to internal stakeholders and ensuring the organisation meets regulatory obligations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an analytically driven professional to deepen their expertise working across a diversified portfolio within a multi-manager, multi-asset superannuation trust structure. The successful candidate will work closely with senior performance analysts and data automation specialist, and develop a genuine understanding of how institutional capital is deployed, monitored and reported at scale. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must, familiarity with investment performance systems is a plus.

We will count on you to:

  • Maintain and reconcile the investment performance measurement system, ensuring data integrity across custodian feeds, unit pricing, and internal records.
  • Perform data quality checks and exception management to identify and resolve discrepancies in source data before use in analytics.
  • Collate and maintain key datasets outside of core systems, documenting data definitions, methodologies, and procedures in accordance with data governance guidelines.
  • Support the development and maintenance of benchmark indices and composite calculations where applicable.
  • Assist senior performance analysts in attribution analysis to decompose performance against benchmarks.
  • Coordinate with custodian, data vendor, fund accounting, and investment management teams to gather source data required for regulatory submissions.
  • Provide analytical support and clear explanations of investment outcomes and regulatory data to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Respond to ad hoc data requests, including collating, manipulating and presenting data from multiple sources to support decision-making or analysis.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance processes through automation, improved data sourcing, or risk mitigation.
  • Support internal and external audit processes by providing documentation, reconciliations, and explanations as required.
  • Contribute to project work related to performance system upgrades, data warehouse development, or regulatory change programs.

What you need to have:

  • High attention to detail with a track record of producing accurate, audit-ready outputs under deadline pressure.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, VBA, and complex formulae; experience with SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Strong understanding of investment concepts including asset classes, benchmarks, return attribution, and risk metrics.
  • Tertiary qualification in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in investment performance reporting, fund operations, or financial data analysis within a superannuation fund, asset manager, custodian, or financial services firm.

What makes you stand out:

  • Experience with investment performance systems.
  • Progress towards relevant qualifications such as CFA or CIPM.
  • Experience driving process improvements through automation, data sourcing enhancements, or risk mitigation.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Mercer is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Mercer, visit mercer.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applications will only be considered from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia. Successful applicants will be required to complete a Criminal & Bankruptcy check prior to commencing of employment.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Business Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to translate business needs into practical technology solutions within a healthcare-focused environment.
You will work closely with business users, technology teams, vendors, and stakeholders to understand requirements and shape effective application solutions.
The position combines business process analysis, functional design, documentation, user engagement, and application support.
You will contribute to new development initiatives, enhancements, rollouts, and continuous improvements while ensuring solutions meet agreed scope and quality standards.
The role provides significant exposure to healthcare business processes, enterprise applications, Agile practices, and cross-functional collaboration.
You’ll also help strengthen team knowledge through training, documentation, knowledge sharing, and structured problem resolution.
This opportunity is well suited to a proactive analyst who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and enjoys turning complex business requirements into well-defined solutions.

Accountabilities:

  • Gather and analyze requirements: Engage with business users to understand new requirements, enhancement requests, process challenges, and customer needs, translating them into clear functional requirements and use cases.
  • Design functional solutions: Translate business requirements into product-specific designs, configurations, detailed specifications, workflows, and supporting documentation for development and systems analysis teams.
  • Bridge business and technology: Act as a liaison between business users, internal information systems teams, application technology vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Document business processes: Create and maintain functional specifications, process workflows, design documentation, use cases, and other materials required for new development, enhancements, and modifications.
  • Support application delivery: Work under management direction while independently contributing to assigned application areas, ensuring solutions meet business specifications, agreed scope, quality expectations, and delivery timelines.
  • Engage users and stakeholders: Demonstrate new functionality, gather feedback on future requirements, participate in focus groups and workshops, and maintain close alignment with customer business objectives.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer: Deliver formal training and supporting documentation for team members and users covering new functionality, product releases, enhancements, and regulatory changes.
  • Support implementation and rollouts: Assist with activations, deployments, and rollouts while helping teams identify and resolve issues that require development or application expertise.
  • Investigate and resolve issues: Work with support teams to diagnose client questions and problems, document issues and resolutions, and share learnings to improve team productivity.
  • Maintain quality and standards: Ensure deliverables meet defined quality and defect standards while adhering to established processes, documentation requirements, and organizational standards.
  • Communicate project progress: Take ownership of assigned tasks, provide accurate and timely updates to stakeholders, proactively escalate risks or issues, and drive work through to completion.
  • Contribute to team performance: Provide data for performance metrics, actively participate in meetings, contribute meaningful insights, and share domain knowledge with colleagues to strengthen overall team capabilities.
  • Stay current: Continuously develop knowledge of assigned applications, business processes, industry requirements, vendor solutions, and relevant functional practices.

    • Requirements:

    • Education: A bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant training and professional experience is preferred.
    • Business analysis experience: Approximately 2 years of practical experience providing business process and functional support for an assigned product or application is preferred.
    • Healthcare experience: 2–3 years of experience in healthcare is preferred, particularly within environments involving healthcare applications or business processes.
    • Requirements analysis: Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, clarifying, and translating business requirements into actionable functional solutions.
    • Documentation: Experience creating business analysis documentation, functional specifications, workflows, use cases, and related solution materials.
    • Agile knowledge: Familiarity with Agile principles and ways of working is an advantage.
    • Functional expertise: Ability to develop strong knowledge of assigned applications and understand how technology supports business processes.
    • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, and other stakeholders.
    • Problem solving: Analytical and structured approach to investigating issues, identifying solutions, and supporting successful application outcomes.
    • Customer focus: Demonstrated ability to understand customer objectives and maintain a strong focus on delivering useful, high-quality solutions.
    • Ownership and initiative: Proactive, dependable, and capable of independently managing assigned responsibilities while escalating issues appropriately.
    • Collaboration: Comfortable working independently as well as with mentors, peers, support teams, development groups, vendors, and business stakeholders.
    • Adaptability: Willingness to continually expand domain knowledge, learn new application functionality, and adapt to changing business and technology requirements.
    • Travel: Ability to accommodate occasional local or other business travel when required.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work arrangement from India, with the listed location covering Pune/Baroda.
      • Full-time employment with a permanent position.
      • Opportunity to work within a healthcare technology environment and contribute to solutions that support healthcare organizations and their users.
      • Exposure to business analysis, enterprise applications, requirements engineering, Agile practices, and functional solution design.
      • Opportunities for professional development and knowledge sharing through training, workshops, vendor demonstrations, and cross-functional collaboration.
      • Opportunity to build deeper expertise in healthcare business processes and technology solutions.
      • A collaborative environment involving business users, technology teams, vendors, and support functions.
      • Potential for local and business travel, providing additional exposure to stakeholders and projects.
