title: Family Advocate
description:
Job Posting


Job Title: Family Advocate

Organization: Family Promise of Spokane

Reports To: Shelter Program Manager
FLSA Status: Hourly / Non-Exempt
Employment Status: Full-Time (32 to 40 hours a week)

Shift: Must be able to work Day Shift 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. and/or Swing Shift -

2 p.m. to 10 p.m. based on organizational need.


Join Us in Equipping Families to End Homelessness

At Family Promise of Spokane, we believe no child should ever experience homelessness. Our mission to end the cycle of family homelessness.


We are seeking a compassionate, dependable Full-Time Family Advocate to join our shelter team. This role is perfect for individuals who want to make a tangible difference, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are ready to step in when families need support the most. This is a full-time role with benefits.

.

Our Core Values

At Family Promise of Spokane, we live and work by our shared values:

  • Being Radically Empathetic: We step into someone else’s shoes without judgment, meeting people with dignity, humility, and deep listening.
  • Being Collaborative Stewards: We design intentionally, take smart risks, use data and feedback, and always ask how to do it better.
  • Being Curiously Accountable: We honor every dollar, volunteer, and partner by working with trust, transparency, and accountability.
  • Being Intentional Innovators: We ask questions, seek to understand, and own our impact—good or bad. We learn out loud and welcome accountability as a path to excellence.
  • Being Compassionately Competitive: We care deeply and compete to lead, innovate, and deliver better outcomes—driven by purpose and love.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create a Welcoming Environment: Provide a safe, friendly, and respectful atmosphere for guest families, volunteers, and partners.
  • Support Families in Crisis: Offer compassionate listening, emotional support, and practical guidance to help families access services, resources, and case management.
  • Ensure Smooth Shelter Operations: Manage daily shelter tasks such as meal coordination, cleaning, laundry, and inventory, ensuring routines are followed and needs are met.
  • Lead by Example: Support and guide volunteers, interns, and fellow team members to ensure effective teamwork and adherence to protocols.
  • Document and Communicate: Maintain accurate records of guest interactions, incidents, and operational updates. Communicate clearly through internal tools like Slack and Google Suite.
  • Promote Safety and Stability: Monitor shelter activities, enforce safety protocols, and respond calmly and effectively in emergencies.
  • Engage Volunteers: Welcome and train volunteer groups, fostering a spirit of collaboration, gratitude, and shared purpose.


Qualifications

  • At least one year of experience working with families or individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability, or crisis—paid or volunteer. Lived experience is valued.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Human Services, or a related field preferred but not required or equivalent experience.
  • Skills: Strong communication, remain calm under pressure, problem-solving and using sound judgement in a fast paced environment, time management, able to follow-through with tasks consistently, able to work independently and collaboratively with a team, and demonstrate emotional intelligence. Ability to engage diverse populations with empathy, dignity, and respect.
  • Technology: Comfortable using Google Suite, Slack, and basic data entry systems.
  • Driving is considered a condition of employment: While working with families, you may need to drive families to appointments, etc.
  • Language: Command of the English language and ability to clearly document case notes.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Family Promise of Spokane, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team that embodies radical empathy, shared purpose, and authentic accountability. Every day, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Be a voice of compassion and hope for families experiencing homelessness.
  • Work within a supportive, growth-oriented culture that values innovation and feedback.
  • Contribute to a collaborative effort to transform the way Spokane addresses family homelessness.

As you demonstrate reliability, curiosity, and commitment, this is a full-time position with benefits.


Ready to Make a Difference?

If you believe that every family deserves a home and that your compassion, creativity, and accountability can help make that happen — apply today and join us in equipping families and our community to end homelessness.

description:
Description

Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions for our clients and connecting people and capital with ideas. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment.

THE TEAM

Technology is at the heart of our multi-billion-dollar business. Our engineers develop low latency, scalable, and resilient solutions which drive global equities sales and trading at Goldman Sachs.

As part of the GSET Engineering team, Production Engineering partners with trading desks to support execution services for the firm and its clients. This role places you at the heart of our electronic trading business. Technical support specialists help support the day-to-day operations of the electronic trading systems and the trading desks. The team is expected to interact closely with Trading & Sales business users. As part of a global support team, you will provide operational and technical assistance for GSET applications and infrastructure, both for external clients and internal business users. In addition, you will oversee every component of the production environment to identify and resolve production problems as well as assess risk of systems changes and consult on system supportability improvements. As a devops specialist, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and support of a Python based configuration, resource allocation, and deployment system for the electronic trading platform. You will work with external developers to help with the design and necessary implementation for the onboarding of applications into this framework.


RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Own the production environment
  • Develop and support a configuration, resource allocation, and deployment system for electronic trading platform
  • Enhance existing or implement production support tooling and release management system
  • Apply knowledge of core technology and infrastructure including, but not limited to, tooling, testing, automation and monitoring, for reducing operational risk and increasing efficiency.
  • Provide critical day-to-day production support, incident and crisis management with in-depth technical expertise
  • Manage system health proactively through plant monitoring, alerting provisioning and capacity management
  • The Asia Pac team is spread across Americas, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan, China and India. The role requires working as part of the larger global team and collaboratively working with counterparts across the region on both local and global initiatives

Essential Skills:

  • Strong development experience in a programming language such as Java/C++. Previous working as a developer will be a huge plus.
  • Proficient in Python / shell scripts / SQL
  • Proficient in UNIX – in-depth knowledge is a must; Experience supporting applications in a Linux or Unix environment
  • Solid knowledge and experience in software development lifecycle (SDLC), from initial analysis and requirements gathering with users, through design, development, QA testing and production release.
  • Using orchestration tools including Gradle, Git, Confluence, or JIRA.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down and communicate complex issues, ideas and provide multiple solutions to a problem
  • Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with outstanding verbal and written communication skills with other groups, technology teams, and business users.
  • Ability to handle multiple on-going assignments and be able to work independently and under pressure in addition to contributing as part of a highly collaborative and globally dispersed team

Preferred skills:

  • Previous experience of supporting electronic trading environments

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

title: Senior Manager Organizational Design and HR Business Partner
description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Senior Manager, Organizational Design and HR Business Partnership is a strategic execution leader who partners with university leaders to improve organizational effectiveness through organizational design, workforce planning, and strategic HR consultation. Reporting to AVP, HRBP Strategic Enablement, you will help design and execute organizational initiatives while serving as a trusted HR Business Partner to assigned client groups. You will combine your expertise in organizational design methodologies, workforce analytics, and strategic HR partnership to develop data-driven, stakeholder-informed solutions that grow the university's strategic priorities and future workforce needs.

What You'll Do

Organizational Design & Workforce Planning (70%)

  • Support the design and implementation of organizational design initiatives within the strategic framework established by the CPO and HRBP leadership; independently manage organizational diagnostics, detailed analysis, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities while exercising sound judgment and escalating enterprise-level decisions as appropriate.
  • Partner with CPO, AVP HRBP Provost Office, and AVP HRBP SE & Strategic Enablement to translate strategic organizational design priorities into actionable project plans and execution roadmaps.
  • Conduct organizational effectiveness assessments across the university including restructuring initiatives, role design, span of control analysis, and organizational health evaluations using established methodologies.
  • Support workforce planning initiatives by building workforce models, conducting skills gap analyses, running scenario planning, and creating data-driven recommendations that inform strategic workforce decisions, including evolving capability needs driven by changing work and emerging technologies.
  • Develop and maintain organizational design tools and frameworks including role design guidelines, organizational assessment tools, and org design best practices documentation.
  • Analyze organizational data to identify structural inefficiencies, role ambiguities, alignment gaps, and opportunities for optimization; translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional stakeholder engagement for org design initiatives including scheduling discovery sessions, gathering input, facilitating working sessions, and driving communication.
  • Create deliverables for organizational design projects including current state assessments, future state org charts, role profiles, implementation plans, and executive presentations.
  • Apply systemic thinking to organizational design work, ensuring solutions address root causes rather than symptoms and consider how changes impact the broader organizational system.
  • Partner with People Analytics to leverage data and insights that inform organizational design decisions and measure impact of org effectiveness initiatives.
  • Manage organizational design project plans ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met; escalate risks and issues to AVP HRBP as appropriate.
  • Provide organizational design consulting by diagnosing organizational challenges, evaluating structural alternatives, and developing practical recommendations that align with university priorities and operating needs.

Strategic HR Business Partnership (30%)

  • Serve as the strategic HR Business Partner for assigned client groups, providing consultation on talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and leadership challenges.
  • Partner with leaders and People Team (Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Total Rewards, Employee Experience, Compliance, and HR Technology) to deliver integrated people solutions.
  • Support talent management activities including succession planning, leadership coaching, organizational change, employee relations, and workforce planning.
  • Leverage workforce analytics and HR technology to identify trends, provide insights, and support data-driven decision making.
  • Pilot organizational design solutions within assigned client groups and provide feedback to refine enterprise-wide approaches.
  • Provide HRBP coverage for strategic initiatives, interim needs, or complex organizational issues as assigned.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Leverage strong collaboration and influence to partner across Total Rewards, Compensation, Compliance, and People Team leadership, ensuring organizational design aligns with strategy, policy, and equity standards. Engage and influence stakeholders across the university to drive alignment, adoption, and effective execution.
  • Build credibility and trust as a thought partner on organizational effectiveness topics while applying organizational design expertise within the strategic direction established by senior People Team leadership.

Reporting Relationship & Leadership Partnership

  • Reports to AVP HRBP, Strategic Enablement for performance management, development, and day-to-day operational direction.
  • Partners closely with CPO and HRBP leadership (CPO, AVP HRBP Provost Office, AVP HRBP SE & Strategic Enablement) who provide strategic direction on organizational design initiatives and priorities.
  • Receives strategic guidance from People Team senior leadership on organizational design methodologies, enterprise priorities, and decision-making while independently managing the day-to-day execution of assigned organizational design engagements.
  • Escalate complex organizational design decisions to AVP HRBP, Strategic Enablement and senior leadership for resolution and strategic input.

Continuous Improvement & Professional Development

  • Stay current on organizational design best practices, workforce planning methodologies, and latest trends in organizational effectiveness, future of work and skills-based organizations.
  • Contribute to People Team strategic planning by providing insights from organizational design work and HRBP partnership.
  • Support change management efforts related to organizational transformations ensuring effective communication, training, and adoption.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

What We're Looking For:

  • 8 years of progressive experience in human resources with a focus on organizational design, workforce planning, and HRBP work; demonstrated experience building organizational design projects. Including at least 3 years in a strategic HRBP role
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Experience with data analysis and data interpretation, including translating data into actionable organizational design recommendations.
  • Experience with project management and execution, including managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and translating strategic direction into detailed execution plans.
  • Experience in organizational design methodologies including role design, organizational assessment, workforce planning, and the application of compensation principles such as job evaluation, leveling, and market benchmarking.
  • Strategic HRBP experience with credibility as a business partner and consultant to leaders.
  • Experience communicating and presenting to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across all organizational levels.
  • Proficiency with HRIS systems (Workday preferred) for organizational reporting, analysis, and workforce planning.
  • Experience working collaboratively in a matrixed environment, adapting strategies, priorities, and workflows in response to stakeholder feedback and evolving business needs while maintaining alignment with organizational objectives.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

title: Chemist Technologist
description:
Important Notice: Arlington County requires all applicants to thoroughly complete each section of the application, including prior job responsibilities, duties, and supplemental questions. While you may attach a resume, it will not replace a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Arlington County's Department of Environmental Services (DES), is seeking a Chemist Technologist to join their team at the Water Pollution Control Bureau (WPCB) to perform technical laboratory testing and wastewater chemical analysis in a Certified Wastewater Laboratory.

The Water Pollution Control Bureau protects public health and the environment by treating wastewater, monitoring water quality, and ensuring compliance with state and federal environmental regulations. Through advanced treatment processes, laboratory services, and environmental stewardship, WPCB helps safeguard the region's water resources and supports a sustainable community.

The selected candidate will join a collaborative laboratory team that supports critical wastewater treatment, environmental monitoring, and regulatory compliance activities for Arlington County's WPCB.

Specific duties include:

  • Conducting routine and advanced laboratory analyses on wastewater, industrial, stormwater, and environmental samples to support regulatory compliance and treatment operations;
  • Conducting tests in the areas of Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD5), Total suspend solids (TSS), Nitrate, Total Phosphorus, Ammonia Nitrogen and Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen (TKN);
  • Performing chemical and biological analyses on permit and process samples (e.g., E-coli, bacteriology testing) to meet the Virginia Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (VPDES) permit requirements and quality control checks;
  • Performing safety checks including inspecting lab safety equipment and first aid kit, and checking safety showers and eye wash stations;
  • Preparing chemicals, reagents, and maintaining laboratory inventory;
  • Calibrating and maintaining instruments and equipment;
  • Reviewing test results for inaccuracies and/or irregularities from the lab and field;
  • Preparing and reviewing required logs, test records, operator data reports and other documentation; and
  • Participating in internal and external training to learn new techniques and maintain current skills.

The ideal candidate is a curious and detail-oriented scientist who enjoys working in a laboratory environment, applying statistical and algebraic techniques, following established analytical methods, and producing accurate, high-quality results. They are motivated by the opportunity to protect public health and the environment through science and thrive in a collaborative team focused on continuous learning and excellence.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biology, or another directly related science from an accredited college or university; and
  • Some experience performing routine and wet chemistry testing in an environmental laboratory and demonstrated ability to successfully perform instrumental analyses employing one of the following: Lachat/Flow Injection Analysis or other designated advanced testing instrument.

Substitution(s): Additional directly related experience may substitute for the bachelor's degree on a year-for-year basis.

Desirable Qualifications: Preference may be given to applicants with experience in one or more of the following:

  • Using a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or comparable electronic laboratory data management system;
  • Investigating, interpreting, and applying changes to regulations and requirements related to wastewater analysis; and
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Special Requirements

  • Background Check: A pre-employment criminal records check will be conducted. It will include checks of the following: criminal record, driving record, education, professional licensure, and credit history. You will be required to sign a release authorizing the County to obtain your background information.
  • Driver's License: Applicant must possess, or obtain by time of appointment, a valid driver’s license, and must provide or authorize Arlington County to obtain a copy of official driving record. Any offer of employment may be contingent upon favorable review of the applicant’s driving record. Alternatively, the applicant must have the ability and willingness to use alternative methods of transportation to perform assigned duties and responsibilities at locations other than the primary worksite.
  • Resume Requirement: A complete application includes a resume. Please attach your resume to the application and verify that the details of your application provide further evidence of your experience and qualifications as displayed on your resume.
  • Please complete each section of the application including the supplemental questions. Your responses to the supplemental questions are required because they provide us with specific information necessary to evaluate your qualifications for this position. These responses are considered part of the selection process. A resume may be attached; however, it will not substitute for a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please do not write "see resume" as a response to the questions. In accordance with § 19.2-392.15, applicants are not required to provide information regarding sealed arrests, charges, or convictions in response to any questions or inquiries during the hiring process.
  • Working Conditions: This position may be exposed to hazardous and caustic chemicals and microbiological matter on a regular basis where proper PPE is required.
  • Physical Requirements: Medium Work, exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Additional external licensure and/or certifications may be required based on assignment.

Additional Information

Work hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, or within operating hours as approved by the supervisor. This position is classified as essential, and employee may be required to work weekend or holiday hours.

This position is eligible for County government employee benefits that include health, dental, vacation and sick leave, commuter transportation subsidies, tuition reimbursement, as well as a generous retirement plan.

title: CAD Modeler & Visualization Specialist
description:
Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

As a CAD Modeler & Visualization Specialist at Astrolab, you will be the technical execution engine of our design and marketing efforts. At Astrolab, our design function operates within a studio model embedded inside the Marketing organization. We believe that design sits at the intersection of engineering and brand; it is the visual language that translates our technical DNA into a consistent identity that defines a market. You will work day-to-day with our Fractional Chief Creative Director (a world-class automotive ID designer) and our Head of Marketing, taking raw engineering geometry and transforming it into beautiful, accurate, and compelling visual assets.

In this role, you will serve both the design team and the marketing organization. Your output—from Class A surfacing to photorealistic KeyShot renders—will be the primary way the world sees our rovers before they launch. You will bridge the gap between complex aerospace engineering and high-impact brand communication.
Modeling & Surfacing
  • Class A Modeling: Utilize Alias to create high-quality, production-ready surfaces from initial design concepts and engineering data
  • Geometry Translation: Take complex, constraint-heavy CAD data from the engineering team and optimize it for visualization and design iteration
  • Form Refinement: Work closely with the Industrial Designer and Chief Creative Direction to refine the physical forms of our hardware, ensuring they meet both aesthetic and aerodynamic/structural requirements
Visualization & Rendering
  • Photorealistic Rendering: Produce stunning, high-fidelity renders using KeyShot, translating technical CAD into marketing-ready imagery
  • Asset Creation: Build a library of visual assets for use across investor decks, social media, press releases, and the Astrolab website
  • Compositing: Use Adobe Creative Suite to composite renders into lunar environments, ensuring lighting, scale, and context are hyper-realistic and scientifically accurate
Cross-Functional Execution
  • Engineering Liaison: Maintain a tight feedback loop with the engineering team to ensure that visualizations accurately reflect the current state of the vehicle's design and capabilities
  • Marketing Support: Deliver visual assets at the speed of a modern marketing organization, supporting campaign launches, milestone announcements, and brand initiatives
Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial design, transportation design, digital arts, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
  • Experience using KeyShot for photorealistic rendering and lighting setup
  • Experience using Alias for Class A surfacing and complex geometry
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator, for compositing and post-production
  • Experience in transportation, robotics, automotive, aerospace, or a related industry
  • Experience working in a studio environment or with marketing and communications teams
  • Experience working with engineering constraints and CAD files generated in SolidWorks or CATIA
  • Experience with lighting, material textures, Color, Materials, and Finish (CMF), and environmental rendering
  • Experience managing multiple rendering projects and delivering assets within established deadlines
  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration
  • Equity ownership in the company
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • Home office set up reimbursement
  • Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on-site
  • Once a month social hour on-site with food and drinks

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Financial Planning and Analysis Analyst based in India.

This is a high-impact FP&A role supporting a US-based finance organization in a fast-paced, transaction-focused environment.
You will own critical financial models, reporting packages, dashboards, and month-end close activities.
Your work will directly support senior finance leadership and inform strategic and investor-facing decisions.
The role requires exceptional precision, strong financial modeling capabilities, and disciplined reporting standards.
You will work extensively with Excel, Pigment, Power BI, and financial data from enterprise systems.
Operating asynchronously across time zones, you will deliver reviewed, decision-ready outputs for the US team each morning.
This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical finance professional seeking meaningful ownership and exposure to high-stakes FP&A work.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the monthly rolling forecast process, including actuals ingestion, model updates, reforecasting, sensitivity analysis, and preparation of assumptions for senior leadership review.
  • Build and maintain EBITDA bridges comparing actuals against budget and prior-year performance, including waterfall analyses and detailed variance commentary.
  • Prepare monthly business-line reporting packages covering revenue, costs, headcount, and budget variances while maintaining consistent formatting and reporting standards.
  • Maintain budget-versus-actual templates and ensure commentary is complete, accurate, and consistently applied across business lines.
  • Prepare initial drafts of investor reporting packages using data from planning systems and ensure outputs meet high standards of accuracy and presentation.
  • Maintain monthly KPI scorecards covering revenue, EBITDA, DSO, cash, and close-cycle metrics, using clear RAG indicators to highlight performance.
  • Maintain and refresh Power BI dashboards supporting Collections, Analytics, and FP&A stakeholders.
  • Own the financial close checklist, monitor accounting deliverables and service-level timelines, and proactively escalate delays or risks.
  • Partner with Accounting to review and validate monthly accruals before the books are closed.
  • Identify discrepancies, data-quality issues, or process gaps early and communicate them clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Work effectively with US-based finance colleagues across time zones, ensuring deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of relevant FP&A, financial analysis, management reporting, or corporate finance experience, ideally in a complex or high-growth environment.
    • Expert-level Excel financial modeling skills, including the ability to build integrated three-statement models covering the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
    • Demonstrated experience producing EBITDA bridges, rolling forecasts, variance analyses, and waterfall reporting in a real FP&A environment.
    • Experience with Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, or a comparable financial planning platform; hands-on Pigment experience is a strong advantage.
    • Experience developing high-quality management reporting packages suitable for senior leadership, investors, or private-equity stakeholders.
    • Strong Power BI or Tableau skills, with the ability to build and maintain dashboards using structured financial and operational data.
    • Excellent PowerPoint skills and a strong eye for formatting, presentation quality, and financial reporting consistency.
    • Familiarity with Oracle EPM/FCCS data exports and their use in financial reporting is an advantage.
    • Solid understanding of month-end close processes, including trial balances, accruals, journal entries, and accounting timelines.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to financial accuracy and detail.
    • Excellent written and spoken English, particularly for preparing financial commentary reviewed by senior executives and external stakeholders.
    • Ability to work independently and asynchronously with international teams, proactively communicating risks and escalating issues before they affect deliverables.
    • Strong organizational skills, ownership mindset, and the ability to manage recurring deadlines in a high-accountability environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation aligned with the local Indian market, with total compensation potentially including base pay and bonus opportunities.
      • Paid time off, including Casual, Earned, Sick, Special Leave, and applicable holidays.
      • Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities, including training and education reimbursement programs.
      • Wellness programs designed to support employee wellbeing and work-life balance.
      • An inclusive and diverse workplace where employees are encouraged to learn, grow, and collaborate.
      • Opportunity to work with a mission-driven, globally distributed team.
      • Remote work arrangement based in India.
      • Exposure to senior finance leadership, investor-facing reporting, and high-impact FP&A activities.

Job Description

The department of Pharmacokinetics, Dynamics, Metabolism & Bioanalytics (PDMB) is seeking a curious and collaborative Scientific Associate Director for our growing Translational PK/PD organization. The Translational PK/PD Associate Director is an expert mathematical modeler and scientist who independently designs and executes analyses with minimal supervision, guiding drug discovery strategy with a focus on biologics, protein therapeutics, and peptides.

The Translational PK/PD Scientific Associate Director will:

  • Serve as expert PK/PD modeler in cross-functional teams, to make model-informed decisions about drug discovery, modality selection, and dose prediction across therapeutic areas;

  • Integrate in vitro and in vivo data to build PKPD, PBPK, quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), or other mechanistic modeling platforms of drug disposition and pharmacology, to support forward/reverse translation for both established and novel therapeutic targets;

  • Collaborate across our PDMB and broader Discovery / Translational organization to design experimental studies and modeling plans, to identify and optimize drug candidates and guide broader translational strategy across programs;

  • Guide the design of automated workflows for implementing modeling platforms, to inform human PK/PD and dose projections;

  • Provide scientific and modeling guidance to junior colleagues.

In addition to the responsibilities described above, the Associate Director will demonstrate excellent leadership and communication skills, building effective partnerships across departments to guide model-informed drug discovery.

NOTE: This role is available in South San Francisco, CA, West Point, PA or Boston, MA based on candidate preference.

Education:

  • Master's (with 8+ years), PharmD (with 6+ yearS) or Ph.D. (with 4+ years) in pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics, mathematics, applied mathematics, systems biology, computational biology, chemical/biomedical engineering, statistics/biostatistics or related discipline and experience with increasing responsibility and independence in drug discovery / development, within industry, academia, regulatory or non-profit settings

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Experience performing hands-on translational PKPD modeling using standard modeling software (e.g., Matlab, OSP Suite, Monolix, R), for discovery / development of biologics, protein therapeutics, and/or peptides

  • Expert skills in experimental design, mathematical problem solving, critical data analysis/interpretation, and statistics

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Expertise in developing novel translational modeling strategies or automated workflows that rely on PBPK, QSP, or related mechanistic modeling

The Warehouse Specialist plays a key role in supporting the operations of the Maricopa County Elections Department. title: QA/DevOps Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing

  • Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.
  • Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.
  • Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.
  • Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.
  • Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.
  • Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.
  • Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases

  • FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.
  • AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.
  • AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.
  • Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines.

What you should have

  • 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.
  • Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.
  • Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.
  • Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.
  • Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
  • Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.
  • Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.
  • Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.
  • Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.
  • Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.
  • Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks beyond Tosca (Selenium, Provar, or equivalent).
  • Prior experience working with AMS or managed services vendors in an ERP context.
  • Knowledge of Oracle quarterly release cycles and technical impact assessments.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or environment provisioning concepts (Terraform, Ansible).

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $156,000 to $175,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

title: Lead Compute Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to .

The Role

As a Senior Compute Platform Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will be part of the group responsible for building and running the data infrastructure that powers Zeta's platform, including Zeta’s lakehouse platform. The Data Platform team delivers reliable, cost-efficient data processing that scales with growth — so engineers and analysts can focus on business problems instead of wrestling with infrastructure.

The Data Platform team empowers data scientists and data engineers through a Scala data warehouse framework designed for data modeling and the creation of type-safe and easily testable batch jobs. The team also orchestrates a compute environment that simplifies the execution of Spark jobs, facilitating the analysis of terabytes of data with ease and cost-effectiveness. The runtime environment is based on Hadoop clusters on EC2 spot instances, dynamically scaling up as required, ensuring high resource utilization and stability.

Our team is responsible for the development and deployment of the company's next-generation technology, closely collaborating with the company's other branches in San Francisco and Berlin. You will help grow the team through mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge sharing so others can work effectively with our stack.

Essential Responsibilities:

As a Senior Compute Platform Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Operating and implementing new features in the framework and the services managed by the team
  • Engaging with data scientists and identifying ways of improving their experience and productivity when using our framework and services
  • Identifying and implementing computational improvements
  • Making improvements and/or fixing bugs by submitting patches to open-source projects in our stack, such as Spark, Iceberg, Hadoop, Airflow, and many others
  • Acting as an expert on Spark and Scala
  • Mentoring engineers (including through pairing, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions) and helping raise the bar on quality, reliability, and good practices across the team

Desired Characteristics:

  • Minimum 7 years of software engineering experience
  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Math, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience and proficiency in Scala or other JVM-based languages
  • Experience with Spark and/or other large-scale data-processing frameworks
  • Experience with Kubernetes is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of Amazon Web Services (EC2, S3, Athena, etc.)
  • Interest in back-end technologies, architecture, and passion for learning new things
  • Interest in math, statistics, or adtech technology is a plus
  • Analytical approach to problems and pragmatic approach to solutions
  • Ability to work independently and enterprisingly in a dynamic environment where work priorities can change
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to discuss ideas in a distanced and constructive manner

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this role is €120,000 - €130,000, depending on location and experience.

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:

Under the direction of the Solutions Engineering Supervisor, the Applications and Solutions Developer designs, develops, configures, integrates, and supports technology solutions that improve County business operations. The position blends custom application development, solution engineering, platform administration, workflow automation, and modern integration practices.

This role translates business requirements and operational processes into secure, maintainable, and effective technical solutions using custom development, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, workflow automation platforms, public website technologies, APIs, and enterprise integration tools. The position also provides technical support for custom-developed applications, application servers, content management systems, integrations, and public-facing web properties.

This role ensures high customer satisfaction through responsive communication, reliable solution delivery, and collaborative partnership with County departments, vendors, and other IT teams.

CHARACTERISTIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Works with departments, business users, vendors, and IT staff to gather, document, analyze, and validate business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements and operational processes into functional and technical solution designs.
  • Evaluates requirements against available solution approaches, including custom development, workflow automation, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, content management systems, integrations, reporting tools, and vendor-supported platforms.
  • Designs, develops, configures, tests, deploys, and maintains custom applications, workflows, forms, integrations, reports, and related technology solutions.
  • Supports County public websites and associated content management systems, including technical configuration, templates, forms, integrations, enhancements, troubleshooting, and coordination with content owners.
  • Designs, configures, and supports SharePoint-based solutions and related Microsoft 365 services for collaboration, document management, workflow automation, intranet content, and business process improvement.
  • Develops, consumes, documents, and troubleshoots APIs, application interfaces, database integrations, and related system integrations.
  • Provides technical support for custom-developed applications, application servers, application services, integrations, and escalated issues related to supported solutions.
  • Participates in application lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, modernization efforts, security remediation, testing, deployment, and operational transition.
  • Prepares and maintains technical documentation, solution designs, support procedures, user instructions, reports, and recommendations.
  • Coordinates with other IT teams regarding infrastructure, identity, security, records, networking, server, database, and integration requirements.
  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with County departments, IT staff, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders.
  • Performs other duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

Essential Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Considerable knowledge of application development, solution engineering, systems integration, and enterprise technology solution design.
  • Knowledge of requirements gathering, business process analysis, solution design, testing, implementation, and operational transition practices.
  • Knowledge of web application development, database concepts, reporting, workflow automation, APIs, and integration methods.
  • Knowledge of public website operations, content management systems, web forms, content structure, accessibility principles, and related technical support practices.
  • Knowledge of SharePoint and Microsoft 365 solution configuration, including sites, lists, libraries, pages, metadata, permissions, document management, collaboration, and workflow automation.
  • Knowledge of application servers, application services, deployment practices, troubleshooting methods, and lifecycle support practices.
  • Knowledge of identity, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and secure application design concepts.
  • Ability to translate business requirements, workflows, and operational processes into effective technical designs and implemented solutions.
  • Ability to evaluate business and technical requirements against multiple solution approaches, including custom development, low-code platforms, SharePoint, content management systems, vendor systems, automation tools, integrations, and reporting solutions.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex applications, data, workflow, permission, server/service, website, content management system, and integration issues.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain design documentation, technical documentation, user instructions, support procedures, reports, and recommendations.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments, projects, requests, and operational support responsibilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with County departments, IT staff, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Tools and Technologies:

Experience with tools and technologies such as Microsoft .NET, C#, SQL and relational databases, REST APIs, Microsoft Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph API, Dataverse, Azure DevOps, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. Experience with content management systems, systems integration, reporting, and automation platforms is desirable.

CLASSIFICATION SPECIFICATION

To view the full classification specification for Senior Information Technology Professional click here.

1. High School Diploma or GED.
2. Four (4) years of progressively responsible work experience in one or more applicable areas such as technology operations, applications and systems analysis, support, and development, network administration and support, database administration and support or a closely related field.
3. Post high school education from a recognized technical school, college, or university in computer science or a related area may be substituted for part of the work experience as follows:

title: Wholesale Inside Broker or Senior Inside Broker
description:

They provide customer service, resolve client inquiries through efficient communication, and process routine and complex transactions accurately.

Locations: We are currently hiring Inside Broker roles throughout the U.S. Most roles will be hybrid out of their respective offices. However, some remote opportunities may be available based upon experience.

What will your job entail?

  • Market, quote, negotiate, and bind new and renewal commercial casualty business directed to the internal brokerage team

Team & Culture:

  • Active State Property & Casualty license and/or Surplus Lines license

  • Strong background in Commercial Casualty placements

  • Experience handling high‑volume, fast‑paced brokerage workflows for large, complex commercial casualty accounts

  • Proven negotiation skills with insurance carriers and wholesale markets

  • High level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while remaining highly responsive

  • Strong communication and relationship‑building skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Risk Management, Sales, or related field

  • Industry designations such as CIC, CISR, AAI, or progress toward CPCU

  • Established carrier relationships within the commercial property & casualty marketplace

title: Utility Systems Repairer Operator Supervisor
description:
The incumbent is responsible for the operation and maintenance of 250+miles of collection and distribution lines and 3,400 water meters serving nearly 5 million visitors per year across 14 geographically dispersed communities.

The incumbent is responsible for the operation and maintenance of 250+miles of collection and distribution lines. In collaboration with the Chief-Utilities Branch, ensures compliance with the State of Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality as well the Federal EPA rules, regulations, and laws pertaining to water and wastewater to ensure public health and safety. Accomplish employee performance appraisals, provide counseling, recommend disciplinary action or award when necessary. Installs, modifies, and repairs new and existing utility, supply, and disposal systems and equipment such as wastewater treatment and collections systems, water treatment and distribution systems. Installs, modifies, repairs, tests, and disinfects new and existing water supply mains and laterals up to 30" inside diameter using M.J. cast iron, bell and spigot cast iron, ductile iron, plastic, reinforced concrete, galvanized steel, and copper materials. Selects the proper size and arrangement of repair parts. Duties include the repair, replacement, and/or installation of pumps, flocculators, water treatment process components, chemical feed systems, valves, water meters, and fire hydrants. Operate, repair and maintain small water systems including well pumps, spring boxes and cartridge filtration systems. Supervises the operation of a state certified laboratory for water testing. In support of the COR, may perform role of Project Inspector on contracted work. Prepares observation reports as necessary. Incumbent may serve as a COR on select water and wastewater projects requiring the ability to obtain a COR level 1 within 6 months and maintain certification. Responsible for the efficient repair, maintenance and operation of water and wastewater treatment plants, collections systems including lift stations, distribution systems, reservoirs, and ancillary equipment. Documentation for the Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act (LMWFA) eligibility, submission of ALL SF-50s and performance information for each period of temporary/term employment that qualifies for LMWFA. Performance documentation can be obtained by contacting the supervisors for the positions you served in during your 24 months. If they did not complete performance appraisals ask them to provide a statement of performance for each period of service. The statement must specify the dates for each employment period and your level of performance (dates should match the dates on the SF-50s). For more information about the park please visit: Yellowstone National Park

Must provide proof of U.S. citizenship. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Direct Deposit participation required. Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/. Driver's License: You will be required to operate a government (or private) motor vehicle as part of your official duties; a valid driver's license is required. You will be required to submit a Motor Vehicle Operator's License and Driving Record. Vehicle Operation: You may be required to complete training and operate a four-wheel drive vehicle. Uniform: You will be required to wear a uniform and comply with the National Park Service uniform standards. A uniform allowance will be provided. Water Certification: Must have WY Water Certification 1 and Wy Wastewater Certification 1 at time of application or equivalent from another state. Minimum Age Requirement: Applicants must be at least (1)18 years old or (2) at least 16 years old and: (a) Have graduated from high school or been awarded a certificate equivalent to graduating from high school; or (b) Have completed a formal vocational training program; or (c) Have received a statement from school authorities agreeing with their preference for employment rather than continuing their education; or (d) Be currently enrolled in a secondary school and either work only during school vacation periods or work part-time during the school year under a formal student employment program. *Additional Requirements located under qualifications*

title: Sr. Frontend Developer-React UI
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Frontend Developer-React UI based in India.

This role is an opportunity for an experienced frontend engineer to build polished, responsive, and high-performing web interfaces using React. You will contribute across the full frontend development lifecycle, from interpreting requirements and designs to implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization. The position involves developing reusable UI components and scalable frontend architecture that can support evolving product needs. You will work closely with other developers to turn interface concepts into reliable, production-ready experiences. Performance, browser compatibility, code quality, and usability will be central to your work. The environment suits a self-motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and delivering high-quality products within fast-moving development cycles.

Accountabilities:

  • Collaborate with development teams to discuss user interface concepts, application requirements, and implementation approaches.
  • Review application requirements and interface designs, translating wireframes and visual concepts into high-quality frontend solutions.
  • Identify and implement effective web-based user interactions with a strong focus on responsiveness and usability.
  • Develop highly responsive user interface components using React and modern React development concepts.
  • Build application interfaces using JavaScript and established React workflows such as Redux or Flux.
  • Design and implement scalable frontend architecture that supports current and future user interface requirements.
  • Create reusable components and frontend libraries to improve development efficiency, consistency, and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot frontend applications, investigate issues, and debug interface and application code effectively.
  • Monitor, analyze, and improve frontend performance across a broad range of devices and web browsers.
  • Conduct or support browser-based performance testing and use appropriate debugging and testing tools to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Document application changes, technical updates, and enhancements to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to delivering high-quality products within short development cycles while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

    • Requirements:

    • 6+ years of professional experience in frontend development or a closely related software engineering role.
    • Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent technical education.
    • Strong, hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, and React Hooks.
    • Experience with established React.js workflows and state-management approaches such as Redux or Flux.
    • Demonstrated experience building reusable React components and frontend libraries for long-term product development.
    • Ability to translate designs, wireframes, and functional requirements into clean, responsive, production-ready code.
    • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, responsive design, browser compatibility, and web performance optimization.
    • Experience with browser-based debugging tools and performance testing frameworks or software.
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex frontend issues.
    • Good project management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize work and deliver within demanding timelines.
    • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative development team.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, high-quality code.

      • Benefits:

      • Permanent, full-time employment opportunity.
      • Remote and flexible working arrangement within India.
      • Competitive compensation, with the advertised salary range listed as ₹100,000–₹1,500,000.
      • Opportunity to work on modern web applications using React and contemporary frontend development practices.
      • Scope to contribute to reusable frontend architecture, performance optimization, and scalable UI solutions.
      • Collaborative development environment with opportunities to work closely with experienced technical teams.
      • Opportunity to further develop expertise in frontend engineering, React ecosystems, debugging, and web performance.

FACULTY OF ARTS & SOCIAL SCIENCES

ASIAN ENERGY STUDIES CENTRE

Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant (26270108)

The Centre would like to seek applicants for Senior Research Assistant/ Research Assistant with a strong interest in researching sustainable energy studies.

About our Asian Energy Studies Centre:

Our Centre aims to be an internationally recognised hub for sustainable energy studies in the Asian and European regions.

  • We are committed to pursuing excellence in academic research in the areas of sustainable energy, with particular focus from the perspectives of governance in the Asian and European context.
  • We promote informed energy decision-making and improve energy policies in this region, including Hong Kong, by creating new knowledge, providing practical policy recommendations, promoting knowledge exchange, and facilitating stakeholder engagement.
  • We undertake interdisciplinary collaborative research projects, organise academic workshops, public seminars and other engagement events.

Please see our website for more information: https://www.aesc-hkbu.org/

Responsibilities:

This is a dynamic role which will support our research on energy-related studies from governance and policy perspectives, including projects on smart low-carbon communities, app-based energy-saving, energy transitions and solar energy developments in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, the Asian and European regions.

The responsibilities include:

  • Research support: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including, but not limited to, literature review; drafting preliminary academic papers, research reports, presentations; interviews, focus group discussions, field observations; questionnaire surveys, and review of reports and archives.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to attend a written test.

For project and job inquiries, please contact the PI: Prof. Daphne Mah, Associate Professor, GSIS (daphnemah@hkbu.edu.hk).

The initial appointment will be offered on a temporary basis or fixed-term contract of one year.

Rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

title: Specialist Children's Practitioner
description:
ABOUT US

The Salvation Army is a Christian movement and one of Australia's largest and most-loved charities. We believe in doing good that transforms lives and futures for the better. It is this belief which drives us to find new ways and places where we can make a difference. From times of personal crisis to moments of national grief, we are always here — providing support, safety, community, and opportunity.

Specialist Children’s Practitioner

Full-time (part-time hours negotiable) | Darwin, NT | SCHADS Award – Level 5

Why this role matters

he Salvation Army’s Family Violence Services in the Northern Territory supports adults and children who have experienced or are experiencing family violence. Our teams provide a safe, welcoming and inclusive environment that is responsive to individual needs and grounded in a feminist, trauma informed practice framework. Children’s voices, experiences and healing are central to our work. This role plays a vital part in helping children rebuild safety, confidence and connection after trauma, ensuring they are supported in ways that are culturally responsive, empowering and deeply respectful of their individual needs.

About the role

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Specialist Children’s Practitioner to join our NT Family Violence Services. This permanent, full-time role, provides trauma informed case management and therapeutic interventions to children who have experienced family violence. You will work closely with the specialist FV team to deliver holistic, child centred support that strengthens wellbeing, safety and recovery.

Your work will include individual and group interventions, secondary consultations with staff, and the development of resources that support children’s healing. You will hold space for children’s voices, advocate for their needs, and contribute to a collaborative, culturally safe service environment. This is a deeply meaningful role where your expertise can shape brighter futures for children and families.

This permanent full-time position (with part-time hours negotiable for the right candidate) within the Family Violence Service, reporting to the Team Leader. Pay is in accordance with a SCHADS Level 5.

How you will make an impact

  • Providing holistic case management and therapeutic interventions for children

  • Delivering trauma informed support that reduces risk and promotes long term recovery

  • Completing risk assessments and safety planning in line with FV protocols

  • Offering secondary consultations to support staff working with children

  • Holding space for children’s voices in relation to Family Law and Child Protection

  • Collaborating with case managers and relevant agencies for referrals

  • Providing education and training to staff

  • Maintaining high-quality notes and meeting data requirements

  • Contributing to a culturally safe environment for children and families

What you will bring

  • A degree in Social Work, Psychology or Counselling

  • Registration with a relevant accredited peak body (AASW, APS, ACA etc)

  • Experience counselling children and families who have experienced trauma

  • Experience supporting women and children impacted by family violence

  • A strong history of working with children from diverse backgrounds

  • Ability to work autonomously with sound professional judgement

  • Excellent written and digital record keeping skills

  • Resilience, integrity and a calm, child centred approach

  • Working with children check

What we offer

  • NFP salary packaging benefits up to $15,900 tax free

  • Entertainment Benefit up to $2,650 tax free

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Financial, retail and lifestyle discounts

  • Discounted health and fitness programs

  • Up to 8 weeks of purchased leave per year

  • Generous parental leave

  • Up to 5 days paid leave to support TSA programs

  • A supportive, inclusive culture with passionate team members

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of children and families

How to apply

If you are committed to supporting children who have experienced family violence and want to be part of a team that creates safety, dignity and hope, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application, including a resume and cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.

Applications will close as soon as a suitable candidate is secured.

The Salvation Army is an Equal Opportunity Employer who provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people. We value and include people of all cultures, languages, abilities, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expressions and intersex status. We are committed to achieving a diverse workforce and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

The Salvation Army is a child safe organisation and is committed to protecting children and young people from harm. All child facing roles will require the successful completion of a Working with Children Check. Applicants for all roles require a mandatory Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.

We value Integrity, Compassion, Respect, Diversity, and Collaboration.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Career Area:

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition
Senior Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML solutions that drive business impact. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in statistics, machine learning, large language models (LLMs), model evaluation, and Python-based solution development. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to develop scalable analytics and Generative AI solutions that improve decision-making, automation, and customer experiences.

Responsibilities
• Apply advanced statistical techniques to analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, identify insights, and quantify business impact.
• Develop end-to-end ML and GenAI pipelines, including data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Build scalable Python-based solutions and reusable ML components that integrate with enterprise platforms and cloud environments.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business problems into analytical solutions and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Stay current with emerging AI, machine learning, and LLM advancements, driving innovation and adoption of best practices.


Skill Descriptors
Business Statistics: Knowledge of the statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical tools and processes to assist in making business decisions.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Explains the basic decision process associated with specific statistics.
• Works with basic statistical functions on a spreadsheet or a calculator.
• Explains reasons for common statistical errors, misinterpretations, and misrepresentations.
• Describes characteristics of sample size, normal distributions, and standard deviation.
• Generates and interprets basic statistical data.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
• Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
• Productively balances speed and accuracy.
• Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
• Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
• Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
• Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
• Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
• Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
• Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Machine Learning: Knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Completes specific tasks and initiatives utilizing machine learning technologies, such as search engine optimization.
• Utilizes specific tools and techniques to process descriptive and inferential statistics.
• Applies specific computing languages and tools in machine learning, such as R and Python.
• Explores to use machine learning in one own areas to make business improvements.
• Conducts data mining and cleaning initiatives.

Programming Languages: Knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of programming; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Participates in the implementation and support of specialized programming languages.
• Conducts basic reviews on writing a specific programming language within a specific platform.
• Assists with the design and development of specialized programming languages.
• Follows an organization's standards, policies and guidelines for structured programming specifications.
• Diagnoses and reports minor or routine programming language problems.

Query and Database Access Tools: Knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Writes, debugs and implements complex queries involving multiple tables or databases.
• Works with aggregate functions, complex joins, groupings, dynamic and embedded SQL's (Structured Query Languages).
• Teaches others about query optimization techniques and facilities.
• Consults on query optimization, interactive queries, testing and verification.
• Evaluates all major database access tools and functions for distributed databases.
• Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various SQL products.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
• Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
• Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
• Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
• Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.
