title: Mechanical Integration Engineer – DCI Liquid Cooling
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mechanical Integration Engineer – DCI Liquid Cooling based in India.

This is a fully remote engineering role focused on integrating advanced mechanical and liquid-cooling infrastructure for large-scale manufacturing environments. You will shape factory-level mechanical and thermal architectures from early design through deployment and optimization. The role combines data-center-inspired cooling principles with practical manufacturing requirements, including high-density liquid cooling systems. You will work across mechanical, electrical, controls, operations, and external engineering partners to deliver resilient and scalable solutions. Your expertise will directly influence system reliability, efficiency, manufacturability, and long-term operational readiness. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technically complex projects within a global engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design and integration of factory-level mechanical and cooling architectures, applying hyperscale data-center principles to develop scalable and resilient infrastructure.
  • Design air-cooled and water-cooled chiller plants, dry coolers, heat-rejection systems, hydronic distribution networks, and associated mechanical infrastructure.
  • Define cooling performance requirements covering capacity, redundancy models such as N, N+1 and 2N, efficiency, availability, resilience, and scalability.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for single-phase and two-phase liquid-cooling technologies and architect rack-, row-, and facility-level systems, including CDUs, manifolds, and heat exchangers.
  • Establish operational requirements for liquid-cooling infrastructure, including pressure ratings, temperature ranges, flow uniformity, material compatibility, and durability.
  • Coordinate mechanical and thermal integration between facility cooling plants and high-density IT liquid-cooling loops in collaboration with electrical, controls, and operations teams.
  • Review and approve mechanical designs, CAD models, technical documentation, component selections, and system-level specifications.
  • Select piping, valves, fittings, pumps, heat exchangers, and cooling equipment based on fluid characteristics, pressure, temperature, corrosion resistance, performance, and lifecycle cost.
  • Develop and release bills of materials and manufacturing documentation while ensuring compliance with applicable engineering codes, standards, and regulations.
  • Perform or oversee thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical analyses, including flow modeling, pressure-drop calculations, and stress evaluations.
  • Define and lead system- and component-level testing, including leak testing, hydrostatic pressure testing, and performance validation, using test and field data to drive continuous improvements.
  • Lead design-for-manufacturability and design-for-assembly initiatives and optimize the manufacturing and installation of large-scale copper, stainless-steel, and aluminum piping systems.
  • Manage technical relationships with cooling-equipment OEMs, contract manufacturers, fabrication partners, and other external stakeholders.
  • Support system deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and resolution of early-life issues while mentoring less experienced engineers and promoting engineering best practices.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline; a Master’s degree or higher in engineering is preferred.
    • At least 5 years of professional experience in mechanical system integration, with a proven record of delivering successful system designs and implementations in a relevant industry.
    • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, system integration strategies, coordination, and infrastructure design; experience with data-center infrastructure is preferred.
    • Demonstrated expertise in liquid-cooling technologies, including single-phase and two-phase systems, chillers, heat exchangers, CDUs, manifolds, pumps, piping, and hydronic distribution.
    • Knowledge of applicable engineering standards and regulations, including ASME, ISO, building codes, pressure-vessel requirements, and relevant data-center practices.
    • Experience with mechanical design review, CAD models, BOM development, technical documentation, thermal and hydraulic analysis, testing, and performance validation.
    • Familiarity with design-for-manufacturability and design-for-assembly principles, particularly for large-scale piping and cooling hardware.
    • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training may be considered.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, risk-assessment, and decision-making abilities, with exceptional attention to detail.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical reports, procedures, and presentations and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work independently with limited oversight, take ownership of complex projects, establish milestones, identify risks, and drive initiatives through completion.
    • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and with suppliers, customers, and external partners.
    • Experience with stage-gate project lifecycle processes and the ability to mentor and share knowledge with less experienced engineers.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position based in India.
      • Opportunity to work on advanced mechanical integration and liquid-cooling infrastructure with global engineering teams.
      • Exposure to hyperscale data-center cooling principles and high-density liquid-cooling technologies.
      • Ownership of technically complex projects spanning architecture, design, testing, manufacturing, deployment, and commissioning.
      • Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering, operations, controls, manufacturing, OEM, and fabrication teams.
      • Opportunities to mentor engineers and influence engineering standards and best practices.
      • Professional growth within a large, globally distributed engineering and manufacturing environment.
      • Reasonable workplace accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

You will work directly with engineering, product, and design, to create experiences that reinforce the Salesforce brand by delighting and wowing our customers with highly reliable and available services.

Design, develop and deploy features to enhance observability services offered to teams in Salesforce Demonstrate effective service ownership by monitoring their own service and taking proactive actions when incidents happen Interact with customers, engaging in understanding their requirements or issues and address them in a timely manner Work with engineering and product leadership to evolve the feature roadmap by participating and contributing to release planning Champion efforts to reduce engineering toil, by automating manual procedures and move code to config to enhance team productivity Present your work at tech talks, cloud demos and engineering blogs to show case the work and iterate using feedback
Required Skills/Experiences

  • B.S/M.S. in Computer Sciences or equivalent field.

title: Rehabilitation Counselor (Coordinator)
description:
This position is located within VHA Vocational Rehabilitation Service (VHA Voc Rehab). VHA Vocational Rehabilitation Service programs are recovery-oriented clinical vocational rehabilitation services that offer an array of vocational, educational, training, employment, and therapeutic work services. They include skill development, fostering of natural supports, and assistance with obtaining and maintaining employment for Veterans for whom the primary objective is competitive employment.

Total-Rewards-of-an-Allied-Health-VA-Career-Brochure.pdf Vocational rehabilitation utilizes appropriate counseling and training to support persons with functional, psychological, developmental, cognitive and emotional impairments, or health disabilities to overcome barriers to accessing, maintaining, or returning to employment and/or education. VHA Voc Rehab Service includes: Vocational and Educational Assistance, Compensated Work Therapy (CWT), and related services. CWT consists of the following components: Transitional Work (TW), Supported Employment (SE), Community Based Employment Services (CBES), Supported Education (SEd), and Supported Self Employment (SSE). The incumbent provides VHA Voc Rehab services within various settings of the medical center and/or community. Clinical Duties (75%) include: Provide a variety of rehabilitation services using counseling practices and evidence based and informed modalities to aid Veterans with severe disabilities in achieving competitive employment, educational, and independent living goals. These rehabilitation services involve personal adjustment counseling, therapeutic rehabilitation interventions and case coordination services, and professional counseling practices. Provides clinical expertise through the timely application of therapeutic interventions, case coordination, crisis intervention, interdisciplinary team consultation, rehabilitation plan development, and ongoing assessment and job development practices. Supports informed decision making while using professional judgment and counseling skills to assist the Veteran in identifying suitable competitive employment and placement opportunities. Conducts a skillful analysis of their abilities, aptitudes, strengths, needs, preferences, disability conditions, and resulting impairments to guide Veterans with severe disabilities and employment challenges in achieving their goals. Provide psychoeducational and/or psychotherapeutic groups to facilitate effective job search skills, employer-desired soft skills, work and life skills fostering independence and recovery. Collaborates with the appropriate professionals to provide rehabilitation services, including the assessment of vocational interests, aptitude, and abilities by using clinical tests, observations, interviews, evaluations, and specialized vocational assessment instruments. Consult with interdisciplinary teams to enhance coordination of care, ensure medical clearance, and provide for optimal timing of further interventions. Synthesize assessment information to identify barriers to employment and their vocational implications. Completes various quality assurance and improvement activities to improve services provided. 25% of this position consists of administrative duties, including, but not limited to coordinating workforce development services; Coordination and management of the Compensated Work Therapy (CWT) Transitional Work (TW) and Supported Employment (SE) programs, as well as serving as the Vocational Rehabilitation Internship Director, responsible for the overall quality, coordination, and management of the Rehabilitation Counselor internship training program. title: Enterprise Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Enterprise Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist based in Brazil.

This role supports strategic and high-value customers by ensuring they receive the products, services, licenses, and entitlements they have purchased accurately and efficiently.
You will serve as a trusted operational partner for complex licensing, billing, contractual, and customer data matters.
The position combines enterprise customer support, financial resolution, licensing operations, and data integrity responsibilities.
You will investigate discrepancies across CRM, billing, licensing, and support systems while managing sensitive customer issues.
The role involves direct engagement with customers and close collaboration across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Technical Support.
Success requires strong ownership, precision, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently against demanding service levels.
This is an opportunity to have a visible impact on enterprise customer experience and the reliability of critical business operations.

Accountabilities:

  • Enterprise licensing & entitlement management: Accurately assign licenses and service entitlements, rapidly activate purchases, and manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, transfers, and reassignments for strategic customers.
  • Customer entitlement assurance: Monitor license allocation and usage, identify under- or over-utilization, audit customer entitlements, and resolve discrepancies to prevent access interruptions.
  • Contract & billing alignment: Interpret contractual entitlement rights and ensure consistency between contracts, orders, invoices, pricing, and entitlement systems, including complex enterprise agreements.
  • Billing & invoice resolution: Own customer billing inquiries through Zendesk from initial response to resolution, investigate disputed charges and invoice discrepancies, and clearly explain charges, credits, taxes, statements, and contractual information.
  • Credit note management: Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval for credit notes generated by other teams, ensuring appropriate validation against contractual and billing records.
  • Master data management: Maintain accurate customer, billing, and entitlement records; identify and resolve discrepancies and duplicate records; and coordinate updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms.
  • Reconciliation & root-cause analysis: Reconcile information across Salesforce, NetSuite, and other systems, investigate mismatches, and identify root causes to prevent recurring issues.
  • Enterprise change management: Support customer mergers, acquisitions, organizational changes, account hierarchy updates, billing-frequency changes, currency changes, and historical contract corrections.
  • Escalation management: Take ownership of priority entitlement and data issues, coordinating with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Technical Support to deliver resolutions within aggressive SLAs.
  • Reporting & business visibility: Contribute to entitlement summaries, license position and renewal/expiry reporting, data-quality scorecards, customer health assessments, and root-cause reporting.
  • Proactive customer service: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies, anticipate potential customer-impacting issues, provide transparent status updates, and ensure accurate, traceable resolutions during critical business events.

    • Requirements:

    • Systems experience: Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite, with the ability and willingness to learn additional legacy or specialized systems.
    • Customer support tools: Previous experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk is advantageous but not required.
    • Enterprise customer engagement: Comfortable communicating directly with customers about sensitive billing, contractual, licensing, and entitlement matters.
    • English proficiency: Advanced/fluent English, written and spoken, is essential for effective communication with global stakeholders and customers.
    • Technical & analytical ability: Comfortable navigating multiple IT systems, reconciling information across platforms, investigating discrepancies, and maintaining data integrity.
    • Attention to detail: Strong written communication skills and a high level of accuracy when handling contracts, invoices, licenses, customer records, and financial information.
    • Prioritization: Ability to operate under pressure, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet demanding turnaround times and service-level commitments.
    • Autonomy & ownership: Able to independently manage complex issues, make sound operational decisions, and take full ownership through resolution.
    • Cross-functional collaboration: Strong team player capable of partnering effectively with Sales, Finance, Operations, Support, and other stakeholders.
    • Problem-solving: Strong ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, coordinate corrective actions, and communicate resolutions clearly.
    • Customer focus: Proactive, responsive, and transparent approach, with a strong commitment to minimizing customer effort and protecting the experience of strategic accounts.

      • Benefits:

      • Permanent full-time employment (CLT) with a 42-hour work week.
      • 100% remote work option anywhere in Brazil.
      • Hybrid work option for residents of Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo.
      • Compensation in Brazilian Real (BRL).
      • Opportunity to work directly with strategic and high-value enterprise customers.
      • Exposure to Salesforce, NetSuite, licensing operations, billing, contractual processes, and master data management.
      • Collaboration with Sales, Finance, Operations, Technical Support, and BI teams in a cross-functional environment.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise in enterprise licensing, financial resolution, customer operations, data quality, and escalation management.
      • High-ownership role with visibility into critical customer and business processes.
